title: AnyCam: Anything Can Represent Camera for Video Generation
abstract: Camera-controlled video generation re-renders a video along a target camera trajectory, yet moving the camera around an object, the most natural way to change the viewpoint of an object-centric scene, remains difficult. Existing methods condition either on camera parameters, which are scale-ambiguous in monocular video, or on explicit geometry such as warped point clouds or depth, which breaks down under large viewpoint changes. We present AnyCam, a method that represents the camera with an anchor object in the scene: we reconstruct it in 3D and render it along the target trajectory, a camera signal that is scale-aware, view-complete and easy to specify relative to the object. A video diffusion model transfers the content and dynamics of the source video to the new viewpoint. Its H-Concat layout aligns source and target frames in time, so the model can be distilled into AnyCam-AR, a streaming few-step generator for on-the-fly camera control. Both models are trained on paired videos with pixel-aligned anchor renderings from multi-camera videos and static-scene captures. Experiments on diverse datasets and trajectories show that AnyCam performs favorably against camera-controlled video generation and 3D reconstruction methods in camera control and visual quality.
tldr: AnyCam用场景中的锚点物体表示相机，实现尺度感知、视角完整且易指定的视频相机控制。
motivation: 围绕物体移动相机是改变物体中心场景视角最自然的方式，但现有方法要么依赖在单目视频中尺度模糊的相机参数，要么依赖扭曲点云或深度等显式几何，在大视角变化下容易失效。
method: AnyCam将场景中的锚点物体重建为3D并沿目标轨迹渲染，以该渲染作为尺度感知、视角完整且易指定的相机信号；视频扩散模型将源视频的内容与动态迁移到新视角，H-Concat布局在时间上对齐源帧与目标帧，并可蒸馏为少步流式生成器AnyCam-AR；模型在多相机视频和静态场景捕获得到的像素对齐锚点渲染配对视频上训练。
result: 在多种数据集和轨迹上的实验表明，AnyCam在相机控制与视觉质量上优于相机控制视频生成方法和3D重建方法；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: AnyCam提出以锚点物体表示相机的视频重渲染框架，缓解单目相机参数的尺度歧义和大视角变化下的几何失效问题，并提供支持即时相机控制的流式版本，对物体中心视频生成与交互式视角控制具有潜在影响。

title: A Mesh for Every Moment
abstract: We present MEMO (a Mesh for Every MOment), a method that reconstructs the geometry of complete dynamic scenes, captured by multiple synchronized cameras, and extracts a mesh at every frame. Existing dynamic Gaussian splatting methods either model appearance alone or target isolated objects segmented by foreground masks, and all of them recover meshes by TSDF fusion or Poisson reconstruction, whose fixed grids limit the detail they can capture. At the core of MEMO is a per-Gaussian motion model inspired by Gaussian processes, which represents each Gaussian's position and rotation over time as a combination of temporal Gaussian kernels. The model keeps every Gaussian a valid surface element throughout the sequence and carries an implicit representation of the dynamic geometry, so a mesh can be derived at any time from a field defined by the Gaussians. Although common in real captures, large and fast motion poses a challenge that dynamic Gaussian splatting methods usually overlook. To account for it, we design a track-based initialization scheme that fits each Gaussian's initial trajectory to point tracks in closed form. We evaluate MEMO on Blender-Moments, a new benchmark of nine animated scenes with ground-truth meshes at every frame, and on two real-world datasets. MEMO reconstructs the most accurate geometry among state-of-the-art methods, and remains competitive in novel-view synthesis and training time. Project page: https://memo-4d.github.io
tldr: MEMO用高斯过程式逐高斯运动模型从多相机视频重建完整动态场景，并在每帧提取高精度网格。
motivation: 现有动态高斯泼溅方法大多只建模外观，或仅处理由前景掩码分割出的孤立对象，且普遍依赖TSDF融合或Poisson重建提取网格，固定网格限制了几何细节。真实采集中的大尺度快速运动也常被忽视，因此需要一种能从多相机视频重建完整动态场景并逐帧输出高质量网格的方法。
method: MEMO的核心是受高斯过程启发的逐高斯运动模型，将每个高斯的位置和旋转随时间的变化表示为时间高斯核的组合，使高斯在整段序列中保持为有效表面元素并隐含动态几何，从而可由高斯场导出任意时刻的网格。为应对大而快的运动，方法还设计了基于轨迹的初始化方案，以闭式方式将每个高斯的初始轨迹拟合到点轨迹。
result: 在包含9个动画场景且每帧提供真值网格的新基准Blender-Moments以及两个真实世界数据集上，MEMO的几何重建精度优于现有最先进方法，并在新视角合成和训练时间上保持竞争力；摘要未给出具体量化指标。
conclusion: MEMO将动态高斯作为随时间有效的表面元素，实现完整动态场景的逐帧网格重建，并贡献了Blender-Moments基准。该方法有望推动4D场景重建与图形应用，但摘要未展开其局限性与更广泛影响。

title: WorldExpand: Building Coherent 3D Worlds via Sparse Joint Panoramic Expansion
abstract: Constructing complete 3D worlds from a single panorama is challenging because large portions of the scene remain unobserved. Existing panoramic-video methods expand spatial coverage through dense sequential generation, but neighboring frames contain substantial redundancy, long trajectories accumulate errors, and independently generated directions may be inconsistent. We present WorldExpand, which formulates single-panorama world expansion as the generation of sparse, complementary, and high-resolution panoramic observations. This representation concentrates the generation budget on informative scene regions and preserves the fine-grained details required for 3D construction. WorldExpand addresses two key challenges: where to observe and how to synthesize. Our Coverage-Guided View Selection identifies informative target locations using scene-adaptive quadrants and warp-based coverage scores, while our Joint Panoramic Diffusion uses Gaussian-splatting-based geometric warps to jointly synthesize four pose-grounded and cross-view-consistent panoramas. A diagnostic-guided global--local attention schedule retains global attention only in sensitive layers, reducing the training and inference costs of high-resolution joint generation. The resulting posed panoramas can be directly fed into an existing reconstruction pipeline to build an explicit 3D representation. Experiments show that WorldExpand recovers content behind occluders and around distant corners, improves both novel-view synthesis and downstream 3D reconstruction metrics across various datasets, and generalizes robustly to diverse in-the-wild scenes. WorldExpand runs significantly faster than the state-of-the-art panoramic-video method while producing higher-resolution observations with stronger cross-view consistency.
tldr: WorldExpand 将单全景世界扩展转化为稀疏联合全景生成，以构建连贯三维世界。
motivation: 从单张全景图构建完整3D世界时，大量场景区域未被观测；现有全景视频方法依赖稠密顺序生成，相邻帧冗余大、长轨迹误差累积，且独立生成的方向可能不一致。该方法旨在以更稀疏、互补且高分辨率的方式扩展观测，集中生成预算并保留3D构建所需细节。
method: WorldExpand 将单全景世界扩展建模为生成稀疏、互补且高分辨率的有位姿全景观测；Coverage-Guided View Selection 用场景自适应象限和基于warp的覆盖分数选择信息量高的目标位置，Joint Panoramic Diffusion 借助 Gaussian-splatting 几何warp联合合成四幅位姿锚定且跨视角一致的全景。诊断引导的 global--local attention 调度仅在敏感层保留全局注意力，降低高分辨率联合生成的训练与推理开销；生成的有位姿全景可直接输入现有重建管线构建显式3D表示。
result: 实验表明 WorldExpand 能恢复遮挡物后方和远处转角周围的内容，在多个数据集上提升新视角合成与下游3D重建指标，并对多样 in-the-wild 场景具有稳健泛化能力。相比先进的全景视频方法，其运行显著更快，同时生成更高分辨率且跨视角一致性更强的观测；摘要未提供具体量化数值。
conclusion: 该方法的核心贡献是把单全景世界扩展转化为稀疏联合全景观测生成，通过覆盖引导选点与几何一致的联合扩散兼顾场景覆盖、细节保真和跨视角一致性，并可无缝接入现有重建流程。其潜在影响在于为高效、连贯的3D世界构建提供了可扩展的新范式，尤其适合需要从有限观测补全大范围场景的应用。

title: CADENCE: Sensor-GroundedWorld-Consistent Gaussian SLAM for Collaborative Mobile Reconstruction
abstract: Collaborative reconstruction with consumer phones promises faster and more complete indoor maps. However, heterogeneous devices introduce degraded observations and unreliable cross-device associations, so a single poor contributor or incorrect match can corrupt the shared Gaussian map. To address this, we propose \textbf{CADENCE}, a collaborative Gaussian simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) system that separates finding cross-device matches from deciding whether and how peer observations update the map. To find matches, a sensor-grounded regional memory summarizes committed observations and ranks candidate peer regions using appearance, relative pose, gravity, barometric altitude, and observation quality. Deterministic geometric verification and optional physical checks then decide which of the proposed matches are accepted. Once a match is accepted, separate cue-based confidences control how its observations contribute to pose constraints, geometry, appearance, and memory. As a result, useful depth can still contribute even when color is unreliable. Throughout this process, local tracking remains isolated from mapping, verification, and networking. We evaluate CADENCE on eight Matterport3D houses that were not used to train the memory. On these houses, regional memory achieves an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of $0.95$ to $0.97$ and thus outperforms appearance retrieval, while verification keeps false-link rates below $0.5\,\%$. Furthermore, soft confidence weighting reduces the mean receiver peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) loss from $2.66$ to $1.05$\,dB across eight degradations while retaining useful peer depth. Finally, using inertial and platform motion, CADENCE tracks all twelve held-out iPhone scans with a mean absolute trajectory error of $6.98$\,cm, and its refined maps achieve better average rendering quality than the baselines.
tldr: CADENCE 通过将跨设备匹配发现与置信度加权更新解耦，实现鲁棒的协作高斯 SLAM。
motivation: 消费级手机协作重建可更快获得更完整的室内地图，但异构设备导致观测退化、跨设备关联不可靠，单个差贡献者或错误匹配就会污染共享高斯地图；因此需要把“寻找跨设备匹配”与“决定是否及如何用对等观测更新地图”分开处理。
method: 系统用传感器锚定的区域记忆汇总已提交观测，并综合外观、相对位姿、重力、气压高度和观测质量对候选对等区域排序；随后通过确定性几何验证和可选物理检查筛除误匹配。匹配被接受后，用分离的基于线索的置信度分别控制其对位姿约束、几何、外观和记忆的贡献，使颜色不可靠时深度仍能有效参与，并保持本地跟踪与建图、验证和网络过程隔离。
result: 在未参与记忆训练的 8 个 Matterport3D 房屋上，区域记忆的 AUROC 达 0.95–0.97，优于外观检索，验证将错误链接率控制在 0.5% 以下；软置信度加权把 8 种退化下的平均 PSNR 损失从 2.66 dB 降至 1.05 dB，同时保留有用的对等深度。利用惯性和平台运动，CADENCE 在 12 个留出 iPhone 扫描上全部跟踪成功，平均绝对轨迹误差为 6.98 cm，精化地图的平均渲染质量优于基线。
conclusion: CADENCE 证明将跨设备匹配发现与置信度加权的地图更新解耦，可显著提升异构手机协作高斯 SLAM 的关联可靠性、退化鲁棒性和重建质量，为消费级多设备室内建图提供了可行方案。

title: Who Is Ego? Scaling Cross-View Camera Wearer Identification and Segmentation beyond Humans
abstract: A first-person (ego) image reveals what a camera sees, but not who or what carries it. Given a synchronized third-person (exo) image, camera wearer identification asks who is ego: which candidate carries the ego camera? We extend this task beyond humans to robots, vehicles, animals, and drones, and broaden its spatial scope (where is ego) from selecting a provided candidate mask to wearer segmentation with absence prediction and mutual camera localization across ego-exo views. We introduce FindEgo-1M, comprising 1.16M real and simulated ego-exo pairs across 12 wearer types, 17 domains, and 111 test settings. Our approach exploits a geometric relation: the ego camera's projection into the exo image, i.e., the epipole, lies on or near its wearer. We introduce EgoRay-ZS, the first method to turn a frozen feed-forward 3D reconstruction model, VGGT-$Ω$, into a training-free solution for wearer identification and segmentation. Its geometric readout ranks candidate masks or segmentation proposals by angular offset and distance to the ego camera, while the relative pose provides mutual camera directions. We then develop the full EgoRay model through pose-supervised training on FindEgo-1M and label-free test-time adaptation constrained by candidate masks. Without task-specific training, EgoRay-ZS achieves 78.0% identification accuracy on TF2023's original labels, versus 52.9% reported for the dataset-trained PEN. On FindEgo-1M, EgoRay achieves state-of-the-art chance-corrected accuracy of 87.1 and 77.7 on seen and unseen settings. On matched queries, EgoRay also outperforms GPT-6 Astra by 31.6 and 21.3 points on seen and unseen settings, respectively, while running $18\times$ faster. Data, code, and models will be released.
tldr: 提出EgoRay利用ego相机在exo图像中的对极点几何，实现跨视角佩戴者识别与分割并发布FindEgo-1M。
motivation: 第一人称图像只能揭示相机所见，无法说明谁或什么携带相机；现有佩戴者识别局限于人类，且多是从给定候选掩码中选择，缺乏缺失预测、佩戴者分割与ego-exo互定位能力。
method: 构建FindEgo-1M，包含116万对真实与仿真ego-exo数据，覆盖12类佩戴者、17个域和111种测试设置。利用ego相机投影到exo图像的对极点位于佩戴者附近的几何关系，提出免训练的EgoRay-ZS，将冻结的VGGT-Ω用于按角度偏移与距离对候选掩码或分割提议排序，并由相对位姿提供互相机方向。进一步通过位姿监督训练和无标签测试时适应得到完整EgoRay。
result: EgoRay-ZS在TF2023原始标签上达到78.0%识别准确率，高于数据集训练的PEN的52.9%；EgoRay在FindEgo-1M上取得seen/unseen设置下87.1和77.7的chance-corrected准确率，并在匹配查询上分别超过GPT-6 Astra 31.6和21.3个百分点，同时运行速度快18倍。
conclusion: 该工作将佩戴者识别从人类扩展到机器人、车辆、动物和无人机，并拓展到佩戴者分割、缺失预测与跨视角互定位；免训练与完整模型均表现领先，数据、代码和模型将开源，有望推动跨视角具身感知研究。

title: ProManO: Beyond Sim(3) for Metric Upgrade of Feed-Forward Geometry with Visual-Inertial Anchors
abstract: Upgrading feed-forward geometry to metric scale with visual-inertial odometry (VIO) raises the question of which correction should align dense feed-forward prediction with sparse metric VIO anchors. Existing methods use either a similarity transformation, which cannot represent depth-dependent distortion, or a projective transformation, which alters pre-calibrated intrinsics. We prove that the transformations compatible with pre-calibrated intrinsics form a ten-dimensional manifold. Beyond Sim(3), this manifold contains three degrees of freedom (DoF) that locate the plane at infinity and leave residuals growing quadratically with depth range after any similarity alignment. These DoF are invisible in the image and can be resolved only by metric depth along viewing rays or by multi-view constraints. To estimate them, we propose ProManO, a probabilistic manifold optimization framework in which every anchor is weighted by its along-ray uncertainty and inlier probability within a single expectation-maximization (EM) procedure. ProManO certifies the similarity synchronization and refines the plane at infinity only where it is observable, which guarantees an objective value no worse than that of the optimal similarity alignment. Experiments on EuRoC, CID-SIMS, Oxford Spires, and KITTI-360 demonstrate that ProManO achieves the highest mean F1 and outperforms Sim(3) alignment on all four datasets. The project page is available at https://h0xg.github.io/ProManO/.
tldr: ProManO 在保持预标定内参的十维流形上优化视觉惯性锚点，实现优于 Sim(3) 的度量尺度升级。
motivation: 现有将前馈几何与稀疏 VIO 锚点对齐的方法中，Sim(3) 无法表示随深度变化的畸变，而投影变换会破坏预标定内参，因此需要一种兼容内参且能处理深度相关残差的度量升级方法。
method: 作者证明兼容预标定内参的变换构成十维流形，并指出 Sim(3) 之外还有三个定位无穷远平面的自由度；提出 ProManO 概率流形优化框架，在单一 EM 过程中按沿射线不确定性和内点概率对每个锚点加权，并仅在可观测处细化无穷远平面。
result: 在 EuRoC、CID-SIMS、Oxford Spires 和 KITTI-360 上，ProManO 取得最高平均 F1，并在四个数据集上均优于 Sim(3) 对齐。
conclusion: ProManO 将前馈几何的度量升级从 Sim(3) 推广到兼容预标定内参的十维流形，并保证目标值不劣于最优相似对齐；该工作为视觉惯性锚点下的稠密几何尺度校正提供了可观测性驱动的优化方案。

title: Feed-Forward Adaptive Gaussian Splatting for Interactive Medical Volume Rendering
abstract: Path-traced rendering shows CT and MR volumes with realistic lighting, but it restarts after every change of view, clipping plane or transfer function (TF), the map from voxel intensity to colour and opacity, which limits the frame rate. Feed-forward Gaussian splatting models such as RenderFM predict the Gaussians directly from the volume instead of fitting them to each scan, and are fast. RenderFM, however, handles only CT, runs its network again after every TF edit, has no clipping operator, and places its Gaussians on a uniform 3-mm grid that blurs organ boundaries and cut faces. We present RenderFM-Next, a feed-forward model that addresses these limits. One network handles both CT and MR. Its Gaussians are predicted once per volume: a new TF needs no pass of this network, and a clipping plane cuts them exactly, using operators from prior work. The model predicts coarse 3-mm Gaussians for the whole volume and refines them to 1.5 mm only where refinement improves the image. A small score head ranks the coarse Gaussians by how much refining them would reduce the rendering error; at render time the user chooses how many are refined, and those next to a clipping plane are always refined, which sharpens cut faces. We build a benchmark of about 2,000 CT and MR scans with path-traced references under clinical presets, TF edits and clipping. Our RenderFM-Next improves over RenderFM retrained on this benchmark by 2.8 dB on CT and 2.4 dB on MR and renders a 1600x1600 view in 4-6 ms. Refinement adds 0.30 / 0.69 dB over the same model trained without it (0.51 / 1.17 dB on cut faces), and refining a learned 10% of the coarse Gaussians matches a random 50% with 2.4x fewer Gaussians. Project page: https://gaozhongpai.github.io/renderfmnext/
tldr: 提出RenderFM-Next，用一次前馈预测自适应高斯并支持CT/MR、TF编辑与精确裁剪，实现4–6 ms交互式医学体渲染。
motivation: 现有路径追踪体渲染在视角、裁剪平面或传递函数(TF)变化后需重新计算，帧率受限；RenderFM虽前馈快速但仅支持CT，每次TF编辑需重跑网络，无裁剪算子，且均匀3 mm高斯会模糊器官边界与切面。
method: RenderFM-Next用单一网络处理CT和MR，每个体数据只预测一次高斯，使TF编辑无需网络前向，并沿用已有算子实现精确裁剪；它先预测全卷3 mm粗高斯，再由小评分头排序并按渲染时预算自适应细化至1.5 mm，裁剪面附近高斯强制细化。
result: 在约2000例CT/MR扫描、临床预设/TF编辑/裁剪的路径追踪基准上，RenderFM-Next较重训练RenderFM在CT和MR上分别提升2.8 dB和2.4 dB，1600×1600视图渲染仅4–6 ms；细化模块带来0.30/0.69 dB增益（切面0.51/1.17 dB），学习选取10%粗高斯细化可匹配随机50%且高斯数少2.4倍。
conclusion: 该工作将前馈高斯泼溅扩展到CT/MR交互式医学体渲染，通过一次预测、精确裁剪与自适应细化兼顾速度与边界/切面质量，并建立了带路径追踪参考的基准，有望推动临床交互式可视化。

title: AnyCam4D: Ray-Based 4D Gaussian Rendering for Arbitrary Camera Models
abstract: Real cameras are not pinholes, yet most dynamic Gaussian splatting assumes they are. Footage is therefore undistorted first, losing field of view or detail, especially with wide-angle and fisheye cameras. Static Gaussian splatting has largely solved this with ray-based rendering, which suits any camera. Native 4D Gaussians, which model motion in space-time, cannot use it directly: each Gaussian's orientation and size cannot be recovered reliably from its covariance. We present AnyCam4D, which trains native 4D Gaussians on original footage by ray-based rasterization, preserving field of view and resolution at about the per-step cost of standard projection. Our key contribution is a numerically stable way to obtain orientation and size: we condition a square root of the 4D covariance. Trained models render through other cameras, with rolling shutter, depth of field or chromatic aberration. With a synthetic 170-degree fisheye camera, training on original images improves peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) by 3.0-8.1 dB. On real footage, AnyCam4D has lower perceptual error than the standard projection adapted to each camera, at comparable PSNR and without camera-specific derivations. With the synthetic camera rotated 60-80 degrees away from the capture rig's view, it leads by 6.2 dB against ground truth.
tldr: 提出AnyCam4D，用射线光栅化在原始鱼眼/广角视频上训练原生4D高斯，实现任意相机模型动态场景渲染。
motivation: 多数动态高斯泼溅假设针孔相机，需先去畸变，导致广角/鱼眼画面视场与细节损失；静态高斯已用射线渲染适配任意相机，但原生4D高斯因协方差难以可靠恢复朝向和尺寸而无法直接使用。
method: AnyCam4D直接在原始视频上以射线光栅化训练原生4D高斯，保持视场与分辨率，单步开销接近标准投影；核心是对4D协方差平方根进行条件化，数值稳定地得到每个高斯的朝向与尺寸。
result: 在170°合成鱼眼相机上，用原始图像训练使PSNR提升3.0–8.1 dB；真实视频上感知误差低于逐相机适配的标准投影，PSNR相当且无需相机特定推导；合成相机相对采集视角旋转60–80°时领先6.2 dB。
conclusion: 方法支持鱼眼/广角等任意相机模型，并可渲染滚动快门、景深和色差；避免去畸变和相机特定推导，为动态场景的新视角合成与宽视场重建提供通用方案。

title: OceanFix: Reference-Guided Diffusion for Sparse-View Underwater 3D Reconstruction
abstract: Recent advances in Gaussian splatting have enabled efficient underwater reconstruction, but sparse observations, light attenuation, and backscatter still leave scene regions underconstrained and cause novel-view artifacts. We present OceanFix, a reference-guided framework for sparse-view underwater 3D reconstruction that combines diffusion-based view repair with Gaussian scene refinement. Our repair model follows a two-stage training strategy that separates underwater appearance adaptation from geometric refinement. The first stage learns underwater appearance from reference observations and estimated medium features. The second uses camera poses and reference depth to align reference features, with relative-depth supervision guiding structural repair without requiring target-view depth at inference. We further propose medium-aware distillation that transfers repaired views into the 3D scene according to geometric repair demand and channel-specific optical observability. Through iterative rendering, repair, and distillation, OceanFix refines underconstrained regions while retaining supervision from the observed views. Experiments on underwater datasets demonstrate that OceanFix improves rendering quality in sparse-view 3D reconstruction, reducing visible artifacts and recovering finer scene details.
tldr: OceanFix 利用参考引导扩散修复稀疏视角水下视图，并通过介质感知蒸馏提升 3D 高斯重建质量。
motivation: 水下高斯泼溅重建常受稀疏观测、光衰减和后向散射影响，导致场景区域欠约束并产生新视角伪影。研究目标是在稀疏视角条件下修复这些欠约束区域，同时保留观测视图提供的监督。
method: 提出两阶段训练的参考引导扩散修复模型：第一阶段从参考观测和估计的介质特征学习水下外观；第二阶段利用相机位姿和参考深度对齐参考特征，并以相对深度监督指导结构修复，推理时无需目标视图深度。进一步设计介质感知蒸馏，依据几何修复需求和通道相关光学可观测性将修复视图迁移到 3D 场景，通过迭代渲染、修复和蒸馏细化欠约束区域。
result: 在水下数据集上的实验表明，OceanFix 能提升稀疏视角 3D 重建的渲染质量，减少可见伪影并恢复更精细的场景细节；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: OceanFix 将参考引导扩散修复与高斯场景细化结合，为稀疏视角水下 3D 重建提供了可迭代的修复与蒸馏框架。其贡献在于缓解水下欠约束区域的伪影问题，并提升细节恢复能力，潜在可服务于水下感知与重建应用。

title: MUSE: Multi-Task Uncertainty-Aware Self-Supervised Encoder for mmWave ISAC
abstract: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) allows a wireless system to use the same waveform for communication and environment sensing. At mmWave frequency bands, ISAC enables diverse human sensing tasks, such as localization, gesture recognition, and pose estimation, with high precision. However, each task requires training a dedicated model, typically from scratch on a task-specific dataset, with no mechanism to flag unreliable predictions. This hurts the scalability, transferability, and reliability of mmWave ISAC models. In this work, we propose MUSE (Multi-task Uncertainty-aware Self-supervised Encoder), a unified framework for mmWave human sensing. MUSE leverages a self-supervised transformer model with per-dataset tokenization and is trained via masked autoencoding across five datasets. During fine-tuning, MUSE uses evidential classification heads that enable uncertainty quantification. MUSE replaces N separate encoders with a single shared transformer encoder, an N-times backbone parameter reduction, while achieving a 9.7 percentage points improvement in classification performance compared to the task-specific model, showing that learning jointly across tasks improves per-task generalization. Across four classification tasks, MUSE produces reliable uncertainty estimates that enable selective prediction, improving accuracy by abstaining on the least confident 20% of predictions. We further improve the reliability of the model's confidence estimates using temperature scaling and conformal prediction. Finally, MUSE's uncertainty signal remains reliable even under cross-user deployment, assigning higher uncertainty to wrong predictions than to correct ones 78% of the time, and recovering 9.2 percentage points of accuracy through selective prediction, with no additional retraining on the unseen user.
tldr: MUSE 用共享自监督 Transformer 与证据分类头统一 mmWave 人体感知，并量化不确定性。
motivation: 现有 mmWave ISAC 人体感知任务需为每个任务从头训练专用模型，且无法标记不可靠预测，限制可扩展性、迁移性与可靠性。
method: MUSE 采用带 per-dataset tokenization 的自监督 Transformer，在五个数据集上通过 masked autoencoding 预训练，微调时使用 evidential classification heads 进行不确定性量化，并以单一共享编码器替代 N 个独立编码器。
result: 相比任务专用模型，MUSE 分类性能提升 9.7 个百分点，并将骨干参数减少 N 倍；在四个分类任务上通过弃权最不自信的 20% 预测提升准确率，且 temperature scaling 与 conformal prediction 进一步校准置信度。跨用户部署时，78% 情况下错误预测获得更高不确定性，选择性预测恢复 9.2 个百分点准确率且无需重训。
conclusion: MUSE 表明跨任务联合自监督学习可提升单任务泛化，并提供可靠不确定性以支持选择性预测和跨用户部署，为可扩展、可靠的 mmWave ISAC 人体感知提供统一框架。

title: End-to-End Image-Goal Navigation for Agile Quadrotors via Recurrent State Distillation
abstract: Image-goal navigation asks a robot to reach the viewpoint of a target photograph without a map or goal pose. In three dimensions, this requires not only recognizing the goal but also estimating 3D displacement and generating continuous control actions to approach and settle at the target view. This is difficult because the same visual difference between current and goal image can require very different actions depending on the robot's velocity, yet monocular images alone reveal neither metric scale nor body motion. As a result, existing image-goal policies are limited to planar action spaces and rely on a state estimator for flight control. Policies that map directly from images to low-level control commands have been demonstrated for agile flight, but not toward goal images in unseen environments. We present the first image-goal navigation policy that directly commands thrust and angular rates for agile quadrotor flight in unseen 3D environments, without relying on state estimation (e.g., SLAM, VO, or SfM) or a separate velocity controller. We train a recurrent vision-based policy through a four-stage pipeline that combines geometric and motion supervision with privileged-teacher distillation and end-to-end reinforcement learning fine-tuning. On 1000 held-out flights in unseen environments, the policy achieves an 82.3% success rate with a mean terminal position error of 0.10m across successful flights. Deployed zero-shot on a real quadrotor, the policy reaches an 84% success rate over 25 trials in an unseen indoor environment.
tldr: 提出首个无需状态估计、直接输出推力与角速度的递归图像目标导航策略，在未见3D环境中成功率达82.3%。
motivation: 三维图像目标导航不仅需要识别目标，还需估计3D位移并生成连续控制以接近和稳定在目标视角。单目图像缺乏尺度与本体运动信息，同一视觉差异在不同速度下对应不同动作，导致现有图像目标策略局限于平面动作空间且依赖状态估计，直接图像到低层控制尚未用于未见环境中的目标图像导航。
method: 提出四阶段训练流程训练递归视觉策略，融合几何与运动监督、特权教师蒸馏和端到端强化学习微调。策略直接输出推力和角速度，不依赖SLAM、VO、SfM或独立速度控制器。
result: 在未见环境的1000次留出飞行中成功率达82.3%，成功飞行平均终端位置误差为0.10m；零样本部署到真实四旋翼后，在未见室内环境25次试验中成功率达84%。
conclusion: 这是首个直接命令推力和角速度、无需状态估计的敏捷四旋翼图像目标导航策略，实现了未见3D环境中的仿真到真实零样本部署，表明递归状态蒸馏可弥合单目图像与低层飞控之间的差距。

title: Embodied-VGGT: Preserving Reliable Local Geometry for Long-Sequence Reconstruction
abstract: Long sequence reconstruction must correct accumulated drift while preserving locally consistent geometry. In robotics and autonomous driving, embodied acquisition provides recurring platform- environment geometry and repeated observations of scene structure and platform motion. We present Embodied-VGGT, which exploits these cues to establish reliable local relationships and selectively preserve them during global refinement. Memory-Augmented Grounded Chunks (MAGC) builds on Scal3R's global context memory and uses relative scale references derived from predicted ground geometry to regularize test-time memory updates, encouraging cross-chunk consistency while limiting changes to reliable local geometry. Superpoint Alignment (SA) and Cross-Loop Optimization (CL) jointly address the robust establishment and preservation of geometric relationships. SA balances ground and non-ground evidence across spatial regions to estimate inter-chunk translation. CL uses geometric and motion consistency across interleaved windows to select coherent chunk groups, each receiving a shared Sim(3) correction that preserves its internal relative transformations during global optimization. Experiments on five public driving benchmarks demonstrate consistent and substantial improvements in long sequence reconstruction. On KITTI Odometry, Embodied-VGGT achieves a mean absolute trajectory error of 7.30 m and a Chamfer distance of 2.67 m, reducing these errors by 46.8% and 23.3% compared with the state-of-the-art baseline under same evaluation protocol. To facilitate reproducibility, we released our code: https://github.com/Ang-Sheep/Embodied-VGGT.
tldr: Embodied-VGGT利用具身采集中的重复几何与运动线索，在全局优化中保留可靠局部几何，实现长序列重建的显著漂移校正。
motivation: 长序列重建既要校正累积漂移，又要保持局部几何一致。机器人或自动驾驶的具身采集会反复观测平台—环境几何、场景结构和平台运动，为建立可靠局部关系并在全局优化中有选择地保留这些关系提供了线索。
method: 提出Embodied-VGGT，包含记忆增强锚定块MAGC、超点对齐SA和跨回环优化CL。MAGC基于Scal3R全局上下文记忆，用预测地面几何得到的相对尺度参考正则化测试时记忆更新；SA在空间区域间平衡地面与非地面证据以估计块间平移；CL利用交错窗口的几何与运动一致性选择连贯块组，并对每组施加共享Sim(3)校正以在全局优化中保留其内部相对变换。
result: 在五个公开驾驶基准上取得一致且显著的提升。在KITTI Odometry上，平均绝对轨迹误差为7.30 m，Chamfer距离为2.67 m，在相同评测协议下相较最先进基线分别降低46.8%和23.3%。
conclusion: Embodied-VGGT通过利用具身采集线索并在全局细化中保留可靠局部几何，有效提升长序列重建精度与一致性。该方法面向机器人与自动驾驶场景，并已开源代码以促进可复现研究。

title: UPP-Gauss: Ultrasound Propagation Physics-informed Gaussian Splatting for B-mode Novel-View Synthesis
abstract: Accurate novel-view synthesis of B-mode ultrasound images requires modeling acoustic propagation through tissue and the resulting appearance variations across probe poses. We propose Ultrasound Propagation Physics-informed Gaussian Splatting (UPP-Gauss), which integrates these acoustic interactions into an explicit Gaussian representation. UPP-Gauss constructs acoustic maps by sampling three 3D Gaussian fields using the probe pose and acoustic beam propagation direction, then combines these maps according to ultrasound propagation to synthesize B-mode images. Across three acoustically diverse datasets, UPP-Gauss achieves the best reconstruction quality with efficient rendering, improving PSNR over the best baseline on each dataset by 1.43 dB on average. These results demonstrate accurate and efficient B-mode novel-view synthesis through explicit Gaussian modeling of ultrasound propagation.
tldr: UPP-Gauss将超声传播物理融入高斯泼溅，实现高效高质B-mode新视角合成。
motivation: B-mode超声新视角合成需准确建模声波在组织中的传播及探头位姿变化引起的成像外观差异，现有方法难以兼顾物理准确性与渲染效率。
method: 方法构建三个3D高斯场，依据探头位姿与声束传播方向采样生成声学图，再按超声传播机理融合这些图以合成B-mode图像，将声学交互显式嵌入高斯表示。
result: 在三个声学特性各异的数据集上取得最佳重建质量与高效渲染，PSNR较各数据集最佳基线平均提升1.43 dB。
conclusion: 结果表明显式高斯建模超声传播可实现准确高效的B-mode新视角合成，为超声成像建模与渲染提供新思路。

title: Tortho-Gaussian++: Suppressing Geometric Drift and Floaters for Robust Gravity-Aligned TDOM Generation in Large-Scale Aerial Scenes
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has demonstrated remarkable performance in aerial scene reconstruction, motivating its recent extension to true digital orthophoto maps (TDOMs) generation. We propose Tortho-Gaussian++, a novel 3DGS training framework that suppresses geometric drift and floaters and automatically prunes unreliable peripheral regions, coupled with a robust gravity-aligned TDOM rendering solution. First, we explore geometric support via viewing-ray-based geometric observability analysis, quantitatively characterizing the reliability for each Gaussian and subsequently pruning peripheral regions with particularly weak geometric support. Second, the optimizer state initialization is refined for newly created Gaussians during densification, intrinsically suppressing drift and floaters without external priors. Lastly, a robust gravity direction estimation solution is designed, combining image-derived gravity cues, camera-distribution priors and nadir views, to achieve a gravity-aligned orthogonal projection reference for TDOM rendering. Extensive experiments on multiple large-scale UAV (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) datasets demonstrate that our Tortho-Gaussian++ outperforms vanilla 3DGS by 0.5-3.5 dB in average PSNR and yields comparable or superior performance to prior-guided 3DGS methods. Notably, it reduces the training time, VRAM and Gaussian number by 45.5%, 47.2%, and 58.6%, respectively. Qualitative evaluations confirm that our method effectively suppresses drift and floaters, while robust gravity direction estimation reduces tilt-induced facade artifacts in TDOMs.
tldr: Tortho-Gaussian++通过抑制几何漂移与漂浮物并稳健估计重力方向，实现大规模航拍场景的高质量TDOM生成。
motivation: 将3DGS扩展到真正射影像图（TDOM）生成时，航拍大场景中常出现几何漂移、漂浮物以及外围弱几何支撑区域不可靠等问题，且重力方向估计不准会导致TDOM立面倾斜伪影。
method: 提出基于视射线的几何可观测性分析，量化每个Gaussian的几何可靠性并剪除外围弱支撑区域；在致密化过程中优化新生Gaussian的优化器状态初始化以内在抑制漂移和漂浮物；融合图像重力线索、相机分布先验与底视视角稳健估计重力方向，并构建重力对齐的正交投影参考用于TDOM渲染。
result: 在多个大规模无人机数据集上，Tortho-Gaussian++平均PSNR较原始3DGS提升0.5-3.5 dB，性能与先验引导的3DGS方法相当或更优；训练时间、显存和Gaussian数量分别降低45.5%、47.2%和58.6%，定性结果验证其有效抑制漂移与漂浮物并减少TDOM中的倾斜立面伪影。
conclusion: 该工作为大规模航拍场景提供了一种更稳健、高效的重力对齐TDOM生成框架，在提升重建质量的同时显著降低计算与存储开销，对航拍测绘和三维重建应用具有潜在价值。

title: Revisiting Monocular In-Hand Object Scanning: Dataset, Pose Estimation, and Surface Reconstruction
abstract: In-Hand Object Scanning (IHOS) from monocular video captured by a commodity smartphone holds immense potential to democratize 3D digitization for non-expert users, facilitating applications in digital archiving, augmented reality, and custom fabrication. Yet, IHOS remains largely understudied due to a lack of realistic datasets and systematic benchmarks. To bridge this gap, we introduce ToysRUs, a high-quality dataset featuring diverse figurines captured by 4K Ultra High-Definition (UHD) monocular videos. Studying IHOS from first principles, we examine structure-from-motion (SfM) for camera pose estimation, which is key to IHOS. We identify two key challenges: small baselines between consecutive frames, and sparse feature matches across large-view, long-range frames, further exacerbated by dynamic hand occlusions. Guided by these insights, we propose performing SfM on video sub-sequences sampled at sufficient angular intervals, and iteratively stitches the corresponding sub-trajectories into a unified global trajectory. Furthermore, for high-fidelity surface reconstruction, we introduce occlusion-aware 2D Gaussian Splatting, which incorporates opacity rendering and omits the opacity loss on hand regions. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms existing approaches, including neural implicit representations and 3D foundation models, in both geometric accuracy and photometric fidelity.
tldr: 提出ToysRUs数据集与子序列SfM拼接及遮挡感知2DGS，提升单目手持物体扫描。
motivation: 单目智能手机视频的手持物体扫描（IHOS）有望让非专家用户便捷完成3D数字化，服务于数字存档、增强现实和定制制造，但因缺乏真实数据集与系统基准而研究不足。该工作还针对IHOS中关键的SfM相机位姿估计问题展开分析。
method: 构建ToysRUs数据集，包含由4K超高清单目视频采集的多种玩偶。针对连续帧基线小、大视角长程帧特征匹配稀疏及动态手部遮挡等挑战，在按足够角度间隔采样的视频子序列上执行SfM，并迭代拼接子轨迹为统一全局轨迹；同时提出遮挡感知2D Gaussian Splatting，引入不透明度渲染并在手部区域省略不透明度损失，以实现高保真表面重建。
result: 定量与定性评估表明，该框架在几何精度和光度保真度上显著优于现有方法，包括神经隐式表示和3D基础模型；摘要未提供具体量化数值。
conclusion: 该工作通过新数据集、位姿估计流程和遮挡感知重建方法推进了单目手持物体扫描研究，并在精度与保真度上取得优势，有望促进非专家3D数字化及相关应用发展。

title: SprintGS: Eliminating Redundancy for Fast 3D Gaussian Splatting Training
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) renders photorealistic novel views in real time, but its per-scene training (optimization) remains slow. Recent fast training methods such as FastGS shorten training to a few minutes by reducing the number of Gaussians. Profiling FastGS, we find two costs that remain even in its compact model. First, rasterization is still the largest cost, and redundant work remains in it. Second, the loss computation does not shrink with the number of Gaussians, so its share of the training time grows as the model becomes compact. We present SprintGS, a training framework built on FastGS that keeps the model compact and reduces both costs. For rasterization, scheduled tile culling limits each Gaussian to the tiles where it matters, using a coarse footprint that is annealed to the exact one before training ends; convergence-aware pruning removes converged, nearly transparent Gaussians; and a shuffle-efficient backward pass reduces the data exchanged between GPU threads. For the loss, a fused loss computes the loss and its image gradient in the forward pass without a loss map, removing most of its cost. SprintGS trains 2.15x faster than FastGS at comparable quality, and 1.81x faster in its high-quality setting. It also accelerates other fast training methods and dynamic, sparse-view, and surface reconstruction.
tldr: SprintGS通过消除光栅化冗余与融合损失计算，使3DGS训练相比FastGS提速2.15倍且质量相当。
motivation: 3D Gaussian Splatting虽能实时渲染高质量新视角，但逐场景训练仍然很慢。FastGS通过减少Gaussian数量将训练缩短到数分钟，但剖析发现紧凑模型仍存在两项开销：光栅化仍是最大成本且包含冗余工作，损失计算不随Gaussian数量减少而缩小，因而在训练时间中的占比上升。
method: SprintGS构建在FastGS之上，在保持模型紧凑的同时降低光栅化与损失两项成本。光栅化方面采用调度式tile裁剪，以粗粒度footprint将每个Gaussian限制在真正重要的tile中，并在训练结束前退火到精确footprint；同时使用收敛感知剪枝移除已收敛且近乎透明的Gaussian，并通过shuffle-efficient反向传播减少GPU线程间的数据交换。损失方面采用融合损失，在前向传播中直接计算损失及其图像梯度而无需loss map，从而消除大部分损失计算开销。
result: 在质量相当的情况下，SprintGS训练速度比FastGS快2.15倍；在其高质量设置下快1.81倍。该方法还能加速其他快速训练方法，并适用于动态场景、稀疏视角和表面重建。
conclusion: SprintGS表明，在紧凑模型下进一步消除光栅化与损失计算中的冗余，可显著加速3DGS训练，且方法具有良好的通用性，可扩展到其他快速训练流程以及动态、稀疏视角和表面重建任务。

title: CHD-Bench: Diagnosing Congenital Heart Disease through Interactive Examination
abstract: Diagnosis of congenital heart disease (CHD) requires understanding the spatial relationships between cardiac structures, which clinicians assess by scrolling through CT or cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) slices and rotating 3D reconstructions. Although automated methods have advanced cardiac segmentation, identifying congenital heart defects from volumetric scans remains an open challenge. The two existing approaches rely on handcrafted diagnostic rules limited to static anatomical abnormalities. We introduce CHD-Bench, the first benchmark for interactive CHD diagnosis, defining a multi-label task and evaluation protocol over 247 CT and MRI scans from three cohorts covering 38 CHD types. We also present CHD-Harness, open-source software that runs a VLM in a 3D Slicer environment through 22 tools, manages each examination, and records the resulting diagnosis and supporting views. We evaluate off-the-shelf medical, open weight, and closed weight VLMs and compare them with a 3D CNN classifier and published rule-based results. Gemini 4 Argon with CHD-Harness achieves the highest macro F1 across all three cohorts (0.63, 0.63, and 0.43). Allowing for interactive examination raises its macro F1 by up to 20 points over static views. These results establish CHD-Bench and CHD-Harness as a foundation for developing and evaluating VLMs for interactive CHD diagnosis.
tldr: 提出首个交互式先天性心脏病诊断基准CHD-Bench及CHD-Harness工具，并验证VLM交互检查可显著提升诊断性能。
motivation: 先天性心脏病诊断依赖对心脏结构空间关系的理解，需在CT/MRI切片与3D重建间反复观察。现有自动化方法多依赖手工诊断规则且局限于静态解剖异常，缺乏面向交互式容积扫描诊断的基准。
method: 构建CHD-Bench，定义覆盖三个队列247例CT/MRI扫描、38种CHD类型的多标签诊断任务与评估协议；提出CHD-Harness，在3D Slicer中通过22个工具驱动VLM完成检查管理并记录诊断与支持视图；对比现成医疗、开源与闭源VLM及3D CNN和规则方法。
result: Gemini 4 Argon结合CHD-Harness在三个队列上取得最高macro F1（0.63、0.63、0.43）；允许交互式检查后，其macro F1较静态视图最高提升20个点。
conclusion: CHD-Bench与CHD-Harness为开发和评估面向交互式先天性心脏病诊断的VLM奠定基础，表明交互式检查能有效提升容积扫描诊断表现。

title: DualCast: Dual-Image Conditioned Diffusion Transformers for Digital Human E-Commerce Video Generation
abstract: Recent advances in world models for game interaction and control have increased the demand for large-scale gameplay videos paired with camera trajectories. However, capturing synchronized camera trajectories often requires game-specific pipelines, limiting scalability. We therefore propose GameWeaver, a unified diffusion framework that automatically produces paired video--camera data through three complementary tasks: camera pose estimation from observed video, video generation along a prescribed camera trajectory, and joint video--camera generation from a reference image and text. First, each tipxel stores the normalized 3D coordinates of a pixel ray's endpoint in a reference coordinate frame. The resulting three-channel tipxel fields and RGB frames share the pretrained video model's VAE. Next, a fully trainable dual-stream Transformer exchanges appearance and geometry features through bidirectional gated attention and conditions both streams on shared text features. Finally, deterministic fitting recovers camera intrinsics and normalized trajectories from generated tipxel fields. In our evaluation tasks, GameWeaver achieves a normalized translation MSE of 0.0029 for camera control; for joint generation, it scores 85.48 out of 100 on instruction adherence versus 64.71 for the best cascade on that metric, validating the feasibility of the proposed approach.
tldr: 提出GameWeaver统一扩散框架，通过tipxel与双流Transformer联合生成视频和相机轨迹。
motivation: 游戏交互与控制的世界模型需要大规模且相机轨迹同步的游戏视频，但现有采集依赖游戏专用管线，难以扩展。
method: GameWeaver将像素射线端点的归一化3D坐标编码为三通道tipxel场，与RGB帧共享预训练视频VAE；并用全可训练双流Transformer通过双向门控注意力交换外观与几何特征，以共享文本特征为条件，最后确定性拟合恢复相机内参和归一化轨迹。
result: 在相机控制任务上归一化平移MSE为0.0029；联合生成任务指令遵循得分85.48/100，优于最佳级联方案的64.71。
conclusion: 验证了统一扩散框架自动生成配对视频—相机数据的可行性，为可扩展的世界模型数据生产提供新路径。

title: Efficient Scene-Distribution-Aware Second-Order Optimization for 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) optimization updates the Gaussian parameters one training view at a time, tens of thousands of times. Unlike such single-view updates, multi-view batches reduce dependence on individual training views, and second-order optimization reduces the number of updates with larger, structured parameter changes. Because fewer updates leave fewer chances to correct a change that fits only the views used in one update, scene coverage becomes more important for each second-order update. Multi-view second-order updates, however, are expensive. Pixel sampling reduces this cost, but two issues remain. First, selecting views without considering overlap leaves some views redundant. To address this, we propose a view selection strategy that reduces this redundancy. Second, existing work processes the sampled pixels of each view in a separate pass and recomputes alpha compositing for these pixels from scratch. We introduce two implementation strategies that reduce both overheads by processing the sampled pixels of multiple views in joint passes and reusing the transmittance and accumulated color cached during rendering. On three datasets, our method reaches higher PSNR than the sampled second-order baseline in less than half its optimization time, with competitive SSIM and LPIPS.
tldr: 提出场景分布感知的多视图二阶3DGS优化，通过视图选择与联合像素处理实现更高PSNR且耗时减半。
motivation: 3DGS通常逐视图更新数万次，多视图批处理结合二阶优化可减少更新次数并产生更大结构化参数变化；但更新次数减少后，单次更新对场景覆盖要求更高，而多视图二阶更新开销大。像素采样虽能降本，但现有视图选择忽略重叠导致冗余，且逐视图单独处理采样像素并从头重算alpha合成带来额外开销。
method: 提出一种考虑视图重叠的视图选择策略，以降低多视图二阶优化中的视图冗余；并设计两种实现策略，将多个视图的采样像素放入联合遍历处理，同时复用渲染过程中缓存的透射率和累积颜色，避免从头重算alpha合成。
result: 在三个数据集上，该方法以不到采样二阶基线一半的优化时间取得更高PSNR，SSIM和LPIPS具有竞争力；摘要未提供具体数值。
conclusion: 表明通过场景分布感知的视图选择与联合像素处理，可在显著加速多视图二阶3DGS优化的同时提升重建质量，为高效3DGS训练提供了可行方向。

title: Linear-Time Online Visual Geometry Transformer with Hybrid Architecture
abstract: Transformer-based 3D reconstruction models such as VGGT and $π^3$ predict cameras, depth and point maps directly from many input views. Causal attention models such as StreamVGGT extend them to online video but cache all past tokens, so their total compute grows quadratically with the stream length. Recurrent models such as CUT3R and TTT3R keep a fixed-size state at constant cost, but they progressively forget early geometry. We present LinearVGGT, a hybrid model distilled from StreamVGGT, which uses Mamba2 layers for efficient sequence modeling in three of every four global layers. The remaining layers use register-guided sparse attention to retrieve a few relevant past frames, compensating for the limited exact long-range recall of Mamba2. Our distillation needs only 9\% of the GPU hours and 31\% of the training frames that StreamVGGT uses to learn from VGGT. LinearVGGT keeps an almost constant latency of 27 ms per frame over 1,024 frames and is on average $12 \times$ faster than StreamVGGT. It outperforms its teacher and is competitive with the state-of-the-art streaming model LingBot-Map, while running $2.5\times$ faster and using $2.7\times$ less memory.
tldr: LinearVGGT 用 Mamba2 与稀疏注意力混合架构实现线性复杂度的在线三维重建。
motivation: 现有因果注意力在线三维重建模型需缓存全部历史 token，计算量随视频长度二次增长；循环模型虽保持固定状态和常数开销，却会逐渐遗忘早期几何信息。
method: 提出从 StreamVGGT 蒸馏的混合模型 LinearVGGT：每四个全局层中有三层采用 Mamba2 进行高效序列建模，其余层使用 register-guided 稀疏注意力检索少量相关历史帧，以弥补 Mamba2 的长程精确召回不足。
result: 在 1,024 帧上保持约 27 ms/帧的近常数延迟，平均比 StreamVGGT 快 12 倍；性能超过教师模型，并与 LingBot-Map 竞争力相当，同时快 2.5 倍、内存占用少 2.7 倍。
conclusion: LinearVGGT 以混合架构兼顾线性时间效率与长程几何记忆，为长视频流式三维重建提供了高效且可扩展的方案。

title: ProPolar: Progressive Polar Decomposition for Implicit Neural Representations
abstract: Implicit neural representations (INRs) capture global low-frequency structure during the early stage of training and then refine localized high-frequency details, afterwards. However, standard optimizers are agnostic to the coarse-to-fine learning behavior of INRs. Such optimizers accumulate a gradient matrix in momentum buffer and retain components misaligned with the dominant low-frequency directions in the early stage. We propose a progressively growing rank scheduler and a rank-aware learning-rate scheduler for enhancing a subspace-based momentum optimization, where a momentum matrix is updated within a low-rank subspace. The rank schedule expands the subspace during training, and the scheduler holds the peak learning rate through rank growth so that the added subspace contributes to fine-detail recovery. Experiments on image fitting, single-image super-resolution (SISR), and neural radiance field optimization show that the proposed method improves convergence and peak reconstruction quality over competitive optimizers. The largest gains appear in the high-frequency refinement stage, mirroring the coarse-to-fine progression that the rank schedule targets. A significant study on hyperparameter optimization (HPO) on NeRF further confirms that these gains persist under matched search budgets.
tldr: 提出ProPolar，通过渐进秩调度与秩感知学习率调度优化INR的从粗到细重建。
motivation: 标准优化器对INR从粗到细的学习行为不敏感，会在一阶动量中累积与早期主导低频方向不一致的梯度分量，从而影响高频细节恢复。
method: ProPolar在低秩子空间内更新动量矩阵，并引入逐步增长秩的调度器与秩感知学习率调度器：训练中扩展子空间，且在秩增长期间保持峰值学习率，使新增子空间用于细节恢复。
result: 在图像拟合、单图像超分辨率（SISR）和NeRF优化实验中，该方法相比竞争优化器提升收敛速度和峰值重建质量，最大增益出现在高频细化阶段；NeRF上的超参数优化研究显示在匹配搜索预算下增益仍保持。
conclusion: 结果表明，显式对齐INR的从粗到细训练过程可有效改善优化与重建质量，尤其利于高频细节；该秩调度思路对INR及NeRF优化具有潜在影响。

title: PointX: Multi-View Consistent Intrinsics by Querying Surface Points
abstract: The appearance of a scene is determined by the albedo, roughness, metallicity and normal of every point on its surface, and by the light that reaches it, its irradiance. Recovering these intrinsics from images is ambiguous, and methods that predict them per pixel give the same surface point a different decomposition in every view. We introduce PointX, a simple feed-forward model that predicts intrinsics per 3D surface point instead. A multi-view transformer encodes a set of unposed images, and for any queried surface point, PointX pools the point's tokens across the views in which it appears and decodes the point's intrinsics once. Each point of a 3D reconstruction of the scene, such as a point cloud or a mesh, thus receives a single prediction, which is exactly consistent across views by construction and enables view-consistent relighting and editing. The same model also predicts per-view maps, from one image or many, by querying the point seen at every pixel. These maps agree across views up to the precision of the estimated geometry and correspondences. PointX is significantly more consistent than existing methods, while remaining competitive in accuracy from a single image and improving as views are added. Project page: https://pointx-paper.github.io/
tldr: PointX 通过查询三维表面点实现多视角一致的本征分解。
motivation: 从图像恢复反照率、粗糙度、金属度、法线和辐照度等本征量具有歧义性，逐像素预测方法会让同一表面点在不同视角得到不同分解，导致跨视角不一致。
method: PointX 是一个前馈模型，先用多视角 Transformer 编码无位姿图像，再对任意查询的三维表面点聚合其各视角 token 并一次性解码该点的本征量；对点云或网格的每个点只产生一个预测，从而在构造上保证跨视角一致，并可通过查询每个像素对应的表面点生成逐视角本征图。
result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标；PointX 在跨视角一致性上显著优于现有方法，单图像精度保持竞争力，并且随着输入视角增加而提升。
conclusion: PointX 将本征预测从逐像素转向逐三维表面点，实现多视角一致的本征分解，支持视角一致的重光照与编辑，并为基于三维重建的逆渲染提供了新思路。

title: Lost on Campus: Evaluating Embodied Spatial Reasoning of Vision-Language Models in the Wild
abstract: Embodied Spatial Reasoning (ESR) is central to deploying Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in real-world embodied tasks, yet remains inadequately evaluated. Existing benchmarks primarily assess spatial reasoning in static images or synthetic indoor environments, where semantic shortcuts often suffice, making it difficult to faithfully evaluate spatial reasoning capabilities in the wild. In light of this, we present Lost on Campus, a benchmark for evaluating ESR in large-scale real-world outdoor 3D environments reconstructed by 3D Gaussian Splatting. Our benchmark introduces a unified reasoning-action evaluation framework that seamlessly integrates diagnostic QA for isolated reasoning with closed-loop interactive navigation for active reasoning under multimodal instructions. To enable fine-grained diagnosis, we evaluate six capability aspects of ESR: action grounding, spatial foresight, metric awareness, goal-directed planning, ego-allocentric localization, and spatio-temporal consistency. Extensive experiments reveal that: (i) Compared to indoor settings, real-world outdoor environments impose substantially higher demands on spatial reasoning, where existing models exhibit poor performance; (ii) VLMs still struggle with fine-grained visual alignment, with failures in spatial foresight and ego-allocentric localization emerging as primary bottlenecks; (iii) Improving multimodal interaction capabilities and long-term spatial reasoning is crucial for advancing embodied intelligence. These findings highlight that faithful evaluation of ESR demands benchmarks tightly coupling perception, reasoning and action within realistic and continuous environments.
tldr: 提出Lost on Campus基准，在真实户外3D场景中评估视觉语言模型的具身空间推理能力。
motivation: 现有基准多在静态图像或合成室内环境中评估空间推理，语义捷径可能掩盖模型真实能力，难以忠实反映野外具身任务中的空间推理需求。
method: 构建基于3D Gaussian Splatting重建的大规模真实户外3D环境基准Lost on Campus，并提出统一推理-动作评估框架，融合孤立推理的诊断式QA与多模态指令下的闭环交互导航。评估覆盖动作 grounding、空间预见、度量感知、目标导向规划、自我中心- allocentric定位和时空一致性六个能力维度。
result: 实验表明，真实户外环境比室内场景对空间推理提出更高要求，现有模型表现较差；VLMs在细粒度视觉对齐上仍存在困难，空间预见与自我中心- allocentric定位失败是主要瓶颈。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 忠实评估具身空间推理需要将感知、推理与动作紧密耦合于真实连续环境中的基准。该工作贡献了Lost on Campus基准与统一评估框架，并指出提升多模态交互和长时空间推理对推进具身智能至关重要。

title: Physicl Scenes: An Artist-created 3D Dataset for Learning Perception and Action
abstract: We present Physicl Scenes, a high-quality artist-created and curated dataset of 6,499 3D scenes spanning household rooms, public interiors, and outdoor spaces. The dataset combines detailed geometry, physically based materials, and carefully composed environments with object- and part-level semantic annotations, providing rich, joint supervision for visual and embodied learning. We demonstrate its value as training data across inverse rendering, 3D reconstruction, scene understanding, and mobile manipulation. Across these tasks, training state-of-the-art methods with our scenes improves performance over alternative synthetic datasets. In addition, we introduce a mobile manipulation benchmark, evaluating vision-language-action models performing physical pick and place in diverse 3D scenes with realistic layouts, and using our part annotations to also score where each object is grasped. Our dataset will be released publicly to facilitate research in visual and embodied AI.
tldr: 提出包含6,499个艺术家创建3D场景的Physicl Scenes数据集，并验证其在感知与具身任务中的训练价值。
motivation: 现有视觉与具身学习缺乏高质量、带对象和部件级语义标注的3D场景数据，需要构建可联合监督感知与动作的数据集。
method: 构建6,499个艺术家创建并整理的室内外3D场景，包含精细几何、基于物理的材质和对象/部件级语义标注；在逆渲染、3D重建、场景理解与移动操作任务上训练先进方法，并建立视觉-语言-动作模型的移动操作基准。
result: 数据集覆盖家庭房间、公共室内和室外空间，共6,499个场景；实验表明用其训练在多个任务上优于替代合成数据集，且基准可评估真实布局下的抓取放置与抓取位置，但摘要未给出具体量化指标。
conclusion: Physicl Scenes为视觉与具身AI提供高质量联合监督，并将公开释放以促进感知、重建和移动操作研究。

title: First-Hit Photoconsistency for Neural Surface Reconstruction
abstract: Recent neural implicit and Gaussian splatting approaches have achieved impressive results in multi-view surface reconstruction. However, jointly optimizing geometry and appearance introduces ambiguities. A parametric appearance model can compensate for geometric errors, reproducing the input images accurately without an accurate surface. We demonstrate accurate neural implicit surface reconstruction using only multi-view patch photoconsistency with geometry-based visibility, without volumetric rendering or parametric appearance models. For each reference ray, sphere tracing computes the first surface intersection. Its position and normal define a local patch whose photoconsistency is evaluated across visible neighboring views using colors sampled directly from the input images. For efficient sphere tracing, we use a 1-Lipschitz multi-layer perceptron. We use a single photoconsistency loss, without foreground masks or auxiliary geometric regularization. Experiments show that our method achieves the lowest mean Chamfer distance on BlendedMVS (BMVS) among compared methods and matches the geometric accuracy of leading reconstruction methods on DTU.
tldr: 提出首命中光度一致性方法，无需体渲染或外观模型即可实现精确神经表面重建。
motivation: 多视角表面重建中联合优化几何与外观会引入歧义，参数化外观模型可能补偿几何误差，使输入图像被精确复现但表面不准确。研究旨在仅利用多视角 patch 光度一致性与基于几何的可见性实现准确神经隐式表面重建。
method: 对每条参考射线用 sphere tracing 计算首个表面交点，由交点的位置和法向定义局部 patch，并在可见邻视图上直接采样输入图像颜色评估光度一致性。采用 1-Lipschitz 多层感知机加速 sphere tracing，仅使用单一光度一致性损失，无需前景掩码或辅助几何正则。
result: 在 BlendedMVS 上，该方法相比对比方法取得最低的平均 Chamfer 距离；在 DTU 上，其几何精度与领先的重建方法相当。
conclusion: 结果表明，仅依靠首命中 patch 光度一致性即可避免外观与几何之间的歧义，并在不依赖体渲染或参数化外观模型的情况下实现高精度神经表面重建。该工作简化了监督与建模流程，对多视角表面重建具有潜在影响。

title: CityRecast: Suppressing Persistent Artifacts in Generative Satellite 3D Reconstruction
abstract: Satellite-based 3D reconstruction is limited by sparse observations and changes across acquisition dates. Existing methods use generative priors to recover missing visual detail, but ghosting, streaking, and blur persist in their Gaussian scenes. These artifacts become particularly apparent in low-elevation renderings. We introduce CityRecast to suppress these artifacts through Gaussian scene repair and supervision calibration. To correct the Gaussian distributions that produce these artifacts, we first use multi-angle warm-up to constrain their spatial extent. This reduces the initial ghosting carried into progressive refinement. Surface-guided replacement then continues to repair the Gaussian distribution while preserving existing appearance. To provide more reliable supervision for this process, observation calibration mitigates interference from multi-temporal observations. Joint refinement further reduces conflicts among generated views. Experiments on DFC2019 and IARPA demonstrate reduced artifacts in low-elevation renderings while maintaining satellite-view fidelity. Compared with Skyfall-GS, CityRecast reduces FID-CLIP by 25.3% on DFC2019 and 51.8% on IARPA. MUSIQ increases by 14.54 and 24.95 points, respectively.
tldr: 提出CityRecast，通过高斯场景修复与监督校准抑制卫星3D重建中的持续伪影。
motivation: 卫星3D重建受稀疏观测和跨采集日期变化限制，现有生成先验方法虽能恢复缺失视觉细节，但其高斯场景仍存在鬼影、拖影和模糊，且在低仰角渲染中尤为明显。
method: CityRecast结合高斯场景修复与监督校准：先用多角度预热约束高斯分布空间范围以减少初始鬼影，再通过表面引导替换在保留外观的同时修复高斯分布；同时利用观测校准缓解多时相观测干扰，并用联合细化减少生成视图间冲突。
result: 在DFC2019和IARPA上，低仰角渲染伪影减少且保持卫星视角保真度；相比Skyfall-GS，FID-CLIP分别降低25.3%和51.8%，MUSIQ分别提升14.54和24.95分。
conclusion: 该方法有效抑制卫星生成式3D重建中的持续伪影，在保持卫星视图质量的同时提升低仰角渲染效果，为多时相稀疏观测下的高质量3D重建提供了场景修复与监督校准思路。

title: DOPER: Deep Object Pose Estimation Revisited
abstract: We present DOPER, an RGB pose estimation framework that shares a visual backbone across object detection, segmentation, and keypoint prediction to recover the 6D pose of known objects through Perspective-n-Point. Starting from synthetic training, DOPER adapts to real observations using partial supervision while retaining synthetic keypoint labels. Calibrated multi-view observations provide geometric constraints for keypoint supervision. During inference, optional heatmap refinement fits a rigid pose directly to the predicted keypoint distributions, resolving ambiguous correspondences without depth input or a learned pose refiner. Starting from underspecified CAD models, DOPER progressively refines the object representation and pose estimator. Results on SPEED+ and SHIRT further demonstrate effective adaptation to illumination changes and accurate temporal pose estimation. Across the evaluated single-view and multi-view configurations, DOPER achieves state-of-the-art detection AP results on HANDAL, HOPEv2, HOT3D, and T-LESS while using only RGB and running in real time (35 Hz per object model on one GB300). These results demonstrate the effectiveness of jointly learning detection and pose keypoints, with real observations and geometric constraints.
tldr: DOPER 通过共享视觉骨干联合检测、分割与关键点预测，仅用 RGB 实现实时 6D 物体位姿估计。
motivation: 针对已知物体 6D 位姿估计中真实标注稀缺、CAD 模型不完整以及对应关系歧义等问题，DOPER 旨在仅依赖 RGB 输入实现高精度、实时的位姿估计，并提升对光照变化和时序场景的适应性。
method: DOPER 在检测、分割和关键点预测间共享视觉骨干，通过 PnP 恢复 6D 位姿；先合成训练，再用部分监督与标定多视图几何约束适配真实观测，并从欠定义 CAD 模型逐步细化物体表示和位姿估计器。推理时可选热图细化直接拟合刚性位姿到预测关键点分布，无需深度或学习式位姿精化器。
result: 在 SPEED+ 和 SHIRT 上验证了对光照变化和时序位姿估计的适应能力；在 HANDAL、HOPEv2、HOT3D 和 T-LESS 的单/多视图配置中取得 SOTA 检测 AP，仅用 RGB 且单张 GB300 上每物体模型达 35 Hz 实时性能。
conclusion: 结果表明联合学习检测与位姿关键点、结合真实观测和几何约束能有效提升 RGB 6D 位姿估计；DOPER 为实时已知物体位姿估计提供了可扩展框架，并展示了对不完整 CAD 模型和真实场景的适应潜力。

title: SpatialArena: Where Do Geometric Foundation Models Stand?
abstract: 3D perception is shifting from task-specific pipelines to geometric foundation models: monocular depth networks, feed-forward 3D/4D reconstruction models, and vision--language models that predict geometry. However, their progress cannot be measured reliably. Published numbers are not comparable, because every paper samples frames, sets resolutions, and selects test splits differently. They are not robust because the alignment required for every up-to-scale prediction can outweigh the gap between models: fitting depth in the wrong space nearly triples its error, and standard trajectory alignment understates the error of failing methods by up to $2.6\times$. And they rarely cover long recordings, dynamic scenes, or aerial views. We present SpatialArena, an open arena that scores geometric models with the same metrics and rules, with robust and deterministic alignment. SpatialArena spans five tasks, from monocular depth to SLAM. It covers 23 public datasets with 418,929 images across indoor, outdoor, aerial, object-centric, and dynamic scenes, together with Spatial Arena, our own captures with accurate poses and depth. Evaluating 52 models, we find that single-image depth is close to saturation on public benchmarks but not on large, uncontrolled scenes, and that progress now comes from consistency across frames and views, where feed-forward 3D/4D models match or surpass monocular specialists and overtake video depth models. The benchmark, toolbox, and leaderboard will be publicly released.
tldr: SpatialArena 统一评测 52 个几何基础模型，揭示跨帧与跨视角一致性是新瓶颈。
motivation: 现有几何基础模型的已发表指标因帧采样、分辨率和测试划分不同而不可比，且上采样尺度预测的对齐方式会显著影响结论：在错误空间拟合深度可使误差接近三倍，标准轨迹对齐会将失败方法的误差低估最多 2.6 倍。现有评测还较少覆盖长视频、动态场景和航拍视角。
method: 提出开放评测平台 SpatialArena，以统一指标和规则、稳健且确定性的对齐方式评测几何模型，覆盖从单目深度到 SLAM 的五类任务、23 个公开数据集共 418,929 张图像，并加入自带精确位姿与深度的 Spatial Arena 采集数据，系统评估 52 个模型。
result: 实验发现单图像深度在公开基准上接近饱和，但在大规模非受控场景中仍不足；性能提升越来越依赖跨帧和跨视角一致性，前馈 3D/4D 模型在该维度匹配或超过单目专家，并优于视频深度模型。
conclusion: SpatialArena 通过统一、稳健的评测协议提升了几何基础模型比较的可复现性与公平性，并将评测重点引向跨帧/跨视角一致性；基准、工具箱和排行榜将公开释放，有望推动更可靠的几何基础模型研究。

title: AnyPrune: Optimization-Free Pruning for Any Feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting Pipeline
abstract: Feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) pipelines reconstruct a scene from images in a single forward pass, representing it as real-time-renderable 3D Gaussians. However, the resulting representations contain far more Gaussians than are needed to render the scene faithfully, especially when there are many input views. This drastically increases memory and storage requirements. Existing pruning methods either require costly re-optimization, which defeats the purpose of a single forward pass, or rely on simple strategies that do not exploit all the available information. We present AnyPrune, a transformer-based, optimization-free pruning module designed to work on top of any feedforward 3DGS pipeline. To remove unnecessary Gaussians, AnyPrune learns and exploits pipeline-specific redundancy patterns through a short single-GPU training on the frozen target feedforward pipeline. AnyPrune achieves better rendering quality than existing optimization-free pruning methods in most settings and generalizes to unseen datasets, as shown through extensive experiments across multiple feedforward pipelines, datasets, and input view counts. It prunes a 1.6M-Gaussian field in about $5\,\mathrm{s}$ on a consumer GPU, faster than every method that merges Gaussians or re-optimizes the field. It can also be combined with the pruning built into feedforward pipelines, pruning further at moderate ratios while preserving or improving rendering quality. Finally, it can even suggest a scene-specific pruning ratio that retains most of the quality.
tldr: AnyPrune是一种无需优化的Transformer剪枝模块，可叠加于任意前馈3DGS管线，约5秒剪除1.6M高斯并保持渲染质量。
motivation: 前馈3DGS通过单次前向从图像重建实时可渲染的高斯表示，但所得高斯数量远超忠实渲染所需，尤其输入视图较多时显著增加内存与存储开销。现有剪枝方法要么需要昂贵的重优化而破坏单次前向优势，要么采用简单策略而未充分利用可用信息。
method: 提出AnyPrune，一个基于Transformer、无需优化的剪枝模块，可工作在任何前馈3DGS管线之上。该方法在冻结的目标前馈管线上进行短时单GPU训练，学习并利用管线特定的冗余模式来移除不必要高斯；还可与管线内置剪枝结合，并能为场景建议保持大部分质量的剪枝比例。
result: 在多个前馈管线、数据集和输入视图数量上的实验表明，AnyPrune在大多数设置下渲染质量优于现有免优化剪枝方法，并能泛化到未见数据集。它在消费级GPU上约5秒剪枝1.6M高斯场，快于所有合并高斯或重优化场的方法；与内置剪枝结合时可在中等比例进一步剪枝并保持或提升渲染质量。
conclusion: AnyPrune为前馈3DGS提供即插即用、无需重优化的高效剪枝方案，显著降低内存与存储需求并保持渲染质量，提升单次前向3DGS管线的实际部署价值，同时支持场景自适应剪枝比例建议。

title: Diving Deeper into Dense Keypoint Localization in Object Pose Estimation
abstract: 6D pose estimation of rigid objects is a fundamental and challenging task in computer vision. Recent dense semantic keypoint-based methods employ binary encoding for efficient global keypoint localization, delivering strong performance in object pose estimation. Nevertheless, the discontinuous nature of binary encoding hinders effective training at high resolutions, while its inherent discrete and quantization errors lead to significant localization uncertainty. We propose GHLAPose, a global-to-local framework that synergizes hybrid Gray-binary (HGB) encoding with local-aware refinement (LAR). Specifically, HGB encoding first alleviates discontinuity to achieve accurate initial global keypoint localization. To further address intrinsic encoding errors, the LAR module estimates uncertainty and refines keypoint localization. This synergy enables a precise global-to-local strategy by aggregating global and local features. Extensive experiments on LM, LM-O, YCB-V, and TUD-L datasets demonstrate that GHLAPose surpasses state-of-the-art methods, particularly on fine-grained metrics. On LM-O, it outperforms the second-best method by 1.4% and 1.9% on ADD(-S) 0.02d and 0.05d respectively, and on YCB-V by 1% on ADD(-S) 0.1d. The code will be available at GHLAPose.
tldr: GHLAPose用灰度-二值混合编码与局部感知细化，实现高精度全局到局部关键点定位和6D位姿估计。
motivation: 近期密集语义关键点方法采用二进制编码进行高效全局关键点定位，但二进制编码的不连续性不利于高分辨率训练，且离散与量化误差会带来显著的定位不确定性。论文旨在解决这些编码缺陷造成的高分辨率训练困难和关键点定位不精确问题。
method: 提出GHLAPose全局到局部框架，将混合灰度-二值（HGB）编码与局部感知细化（LAR）相结合。HGB编码先缓解不连续性以实现准确的初始全局关键点定位，LAR模块进一步估计不确定性并细化关键点定位，通过聚合全局与局部特征实现精确的全局到局部策略。
result: 在LM、LM-O、YCB-V和TUD-L数据集上的大量实验表明GHLAPose优于现有最先进方法，尤其在细粒度指标上表现突出。在LM-O上，ADD(-S) 0.02d和0.05d分别比第二名方法高1.4%和1.9%；在YCB-V上，ADD(-S) 0.1d高1%。
conclusion: 结果表明，混合编码与局部感知细化能有效缓解二进制编码的不连续性和量化误差，提升6D物体位姿估计精度。该工作为密集关键点定位与位姿估计提供了新的全局到局部技术路线，代码将开源。

title: Seeing to Drive on a Single Board: Attention-Free Depth for Onboard Robot Navigation
abstract: A small ground robot can carry one camera and a few watts of compute, but the depth foundation models that could turn that camera into a range sensor are vision transformers sized for GPUs. We bring one to a Raspberry Pi 5 with the Hailo-8L, an accelerator that runs every layer in integer arithmetic, attention included. Quantised for it, Depth Anything V2 loses large parts of the scene, and we measure why: at 449 tokens, 91% of softmax weights fall below one int8 step while carrying 17-33% of the attention mass. Our answer is to distil, not quantise. An attention-free ResNet-34 U-Net student of Depth Anything V2-Large (24.5M parameters) runs at 27.1 FPS on the chip, its int8 output matches its float twin (Pearson 0.99993), and on held-out scenes of its simulated yard it is the most accurate depth network on the chip (AbsRel 0.269 against 0.354-0.530). On 1,000 stereo-verified points of a real outdoor drive it is not resolvably different from the vendor's Depth Anything V2-Small build, while running faster (27.1 vs 21.6 FPS). Ranging obstacles by where they meet the floor needs only the camera height, so mapping, hybrid-A* planning and SLAM run on the Pi's own CPU. In real-time hardware-in-the-loop tests in a Gaussian-splat reconstruction of a real yard, the stack reaches the goal without contact in 7.9$\pm$1.1 of 10 scenes, against 9.2$\pm$0.4 with exact obstacles, and in 7.7$\pm$0.7 on its own pose with simulated wheel odometry (ten seeds each; 8.2$\pm$0.4 with the real Pi and Hailo-8L in the loop, five seeds). The source code, pre-trained models and data are available at https://github.com/itaim18/DANIEL.
tldr: 将Depth Anything V2蒸馏为无注意力ResNet-34 U-Net学生模型，在树莓派5+Hailo-8L上以27.1 FPS实现实时机载深度感知与导航。
motivation: 小型地面机器人只有单目相机和几瓦算力，而可作距离传感器的深度基础模型多为面向GPU的视觉Transformer。直接对Depth Anything V2做int8量化后，Hailo-8L上注意力机制失效：在449个token时，91%的softmax权重低于一个int8量化步长，却承载了17-33%的注意力质量，导致大范围场景深度丢失。
method: 提出“蒸馏而非量化”的路线：以Depth Anything V2-Large为教师，蒸馏出无注意力的ResNet-34 U-Net学生网络（24.5M参数），全整数量化后在树莓派5配Hailo-8L加速器上推理；障碍测距仅利用相机高度与地面交点完成，建图、hybrid-A*规划与SLAM均运行在Pi自身CPU上。
result: 学生网络在芯片上达27.1 FPS，int8输出与浮点孪生模型高度一致（Pearson 0.99993）；在仿真场地的留出场景上AbsRel为0.269，优于同芯片其他深度网络（0.354-0.530）；在真实户外驾驶的1000个双目校验点上与厂商Depth Anything V2-Small精度无显著差异，但速度更快（27.1 vs 21.6 FPS）。高斯泼溅重建场地的硬件在环测试中，10个场景里7.9±1.1次无碰撞到达目标（精确障碍物为9.2±0.4），使用自身位姿加模拟轮式里程计为7.7±0.7，接入真实Pi与Hailo-8L时为8.2±0.4（五个随机种子）。
conclusion: 研究表明在极低功耗边缘硬件上应以蒸馏替代直接量化，无注意力深度网络足以支撑实时单目机载导航全栈。代码、预训练模型与数据均已开源，对低成本机器人感知与SLAM部署具有实用价值。

title: RestPose: Canonicalization for Open Object Pose Estimation
abstract: In object pose estimation methods, predicted poses are expressed with respect to a canonical frame, defined by a reference model of that object. In learning-based methods, an arbitrarily chosen modeling convention defines this canonical frame, which is then used to generate the ground-truth pose-annotations for training. Object pose estimation methods are therefore bound to such arbitrary conventions, restricting generalization. In this work, we propose that such a canonical frame can instead be derived for any object, and present RestPose, an approach towards open object pose estimation that does not require reference models or canonical frame conventions during training. From a single input image, we generate an object mesh and canonicalize it through a geometric and physical analysis of the object, then use foundation model-based dense matching to estimate the pose. We choose category-level benchmarks for our experiments, which contain instances across various object categories and enable us to measure the effectiveness of our canonicalization. Across HouseCat6D, NOCS, and Omni6DPose datasets, we improve on the supervised state-of-the-art methods by 18.3 points in absolute metrics and 13.8 points in scale-agnostic metrics, without requiring task-specific training. Code will be published.
tldr: RestPose 无需参考模型或规范帧约定，通过单图重建网格并几何物理规范化，再用基础模型稠密匹配实现开放物体姿态估计。
motivation: 现有学习式物体姿态估计依赖任意选定的规范帧约定来生成真值标注，导致方法受限于该约定、泛化能力受限。
method: RestPose 从单张图像生成物体网格，对物体进行几何与物理分析以推导规范帧，并利用基础模型的稠密匹配估计姿态；训练时无需参考模型或规范帧约定。
result: 在 HouseCat6D、NOCS 和 Omni6DPose 类别级基准上，无需任务特定训练即较监督式 SOTA 在绝对指标提升 18.3 个点、尺度无关指标提升 13.8 个点。
conclusion: 该工作提出可对任意物体推导规范帧的开放物体姿态估计框架，摆脱参考模型与规范帧约定依赖，并显著提升跨类别泛化性能。

title: Completion-Aware Compression for Progressive 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-quality novel-view rendering, but its large scene representations are costly to transmit. Pruning and compression reduce file sizes, yet progressive delivery also requires usable reconstructions before the full scene arrives. Existing progressive representations provide partial scenes, but level-based updates are limited by predefined coding boundaries. This paper presents a progressive 3DGS codec that balances attribute fidelity with the image benefit of making Gaussians available earlier. Its single compact stream supports partial 3D reconstruction and adds newly decoded Gaussians as more bytes arrive. The stream supports fine-grained updates at arbitrary received-byte budgets, without separate encodings or later attribute refinement. At matched complete-file sizes and received bytes, completion-aware allocation improves 1/8 PSNR over attribute-only allocation by 0.48-1.43 dB. The proposed codec compresses original 3DGS representations by 62-88 times while retaining near-reference Full PSNR. Under the evaluated 50-Mbps delivery model, partial reconstruction becomes available in approximately 0.2 s.
tldr: 提出面向渐进式3DGS的完成度感知压缩编码器，可在任意字节预算下增量重建。
motivation: 3DGS 渲染质量高但表示体积大、传输成本高；剪枝与压缩虽能减小文件，但渐进传输还要求在完整场景到达前即可用。现有渐进表示受预定义层级编码边界限制，只能提供粗粒度部分场景。
method: 提出单一紧凑码流实现的渐进式 3DGS 编解码器，在属性保真度与 Gaussian 提前可用带来的图像收益之间做完成度感知分配。码流支持在任意已接收字节预算下细粒度解码并增量加入新 Gaussian，无需独立编码或后续属性细化。
result: 在匹配完整文件大小与接收字节数时，完成度感知分配相较仅属性分配在 1/8 接收进度下 PSNR 提升 0.48–1.43 dB；整体将原始 3DGS 表示压缩 62–88 倍并保持接近参考的 Full PSNR。在 50 Mbps 传输模型下，约 0.2 s 即可获得部分重建。
conclusion: 该方法实现了细粒度渐进式 3DGS 传输，在显著压缩率下兼顾完整重建质量与早期可用性，为带宽受限场景的渐进式三维内容交付提供了有效方案。

title: DiffAnchor: Anchor-Space Diffusion for Monocular 3D Hand Pose Estimation
abstract: Accurate and efficient monocular 3D hand pose estimation is an important perception capability for embodied human interaction and dexterous manipulation. Recent diffusion-based methods model pose uncertainty by iteratively denoising 3D joint coordinates. However, directly diffusing the final joints requires the generative process to simultaneously explore plausible poses and recover precise coordinates, often relying on additional denoising steps or multiple hypotheses and consequently increasing inference cost. In this work, we propose DiffAnchor, a few-step anchor-space diffusion framework that diffuses anchors rather than joints. Our key insight is that stochastic exploration does not need to operate directly on the final output. Instead, diffusion searches for informative intermediate anchors that serve as local 3D regressors, while anchor-to-joint offset prediction and weighted aggregation complete precise joint localization. Specifically, fixed context anchors provide stable global references, whereas noisy dynamic anchors are iteratively refined toward informative joint regions. An importance-guided anchor selection and replenishment mechanism further retains useful anchors, removes ineffective ones, and explores insufficiently covered regions. This design reduces the precision burden of the diffusion process and enables accurate prediction using only a few denoising steps and a single hypothesis. Extensive experiments on HO-3D V2, NYU, ICVL, and InterHand2.6M demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on the first three benchmarks and competitive performance on challenging interacting-hand estimation, while maintaining inference efficiency comparable to deterministic regression baselines.
tldr: DiffAnchor将扩散从关节坐标转移到锚点空间，用少步单假设实现高效精确的单目3D手部姿态估计。
motivation: 现有扩散式方法直接对最终3D关节坐标去噪，生成过程需同时探索合理姿态并恢复精确坐标，往往依赖更多去噪步或多假设，推理成本高。本文旨在降低扩散过程的精度负担，实现少步数、单假设的高效精确估计。
method: 提出锚点空间扩散框架，扩散对象由关节改为锚点：固定上下文锚点提供稳定全局参考，噪声动态锚点被迭代精炼至有信息量的关节区域，再由锚点到关节的偏移预测与加权聚合完成精确定位。同时设计重要性引导的锚点选择与补充机制，保留有效锚点、剔除无效锚点并探索覆盖不足区域。
result: 在HO-3D V2、NYU、ICVL三个基准上取得SOTA性能，在更具挑战的InterHand2.6M双手交互估计上表现具有竞争力，且推理效率与确定性回归基线相当，仅需少量去噪步和单一假设。
conclusion: 该工作表明随机探索无需直接作用于最终输出，将扩散置于中间锚点空间可在少步单假设下兼顾精度与效率，为高效生成式3D手部姿态估计提供了新思路，并适用于具身交互与灵巧操作等场景。

title: X-3DComposer: Feed-Forward 3D Scene Composition with Any Assets from Any Views
abstract: Composing an editable 3D scene from images requires an asset for each object and a layout that places the assets. 3D generation and CAD retrieval now supply the assets, but layout still lacks a general solution: scene generation methods couple it with generation, and pose estimators handle one object at a time and need true-size CAD models, depth, or iterative refinement. We present X-3DComposer, a feed-forward model that predicts the layout separately from asset generation. Given one or more images of a scene, the object masks, and an asset for each object from any source, it jointly predicts the rotation, translation, and per-axis scale of all objects in a single forward pass of about one second. The key idea is to treat objects as views: renders of the assets are processed together with the scene images by a multi-view geometry model adapted from VGGT-$Ω$, and each object pose follows in closed form from the cameras predicted for its renders. Camera intrinsics, camera poses, and depth are optional inputs. When the meshes produced by five scene generation methods are kept fixed and only their layout is replaced, the layouts of X-3DComposer are more accurate than the native layouts of these methods. Compared with the stand-alone layout model SceneMaker, it reduces the scene-level Chamfer distance by 52% on IndoorMix, our test set from six indoor datasets, and by 28% on 3D-FUTURE.
tldr: 将物体视为视图，用多视图几何模型一次前向预测场景中所有物体的位姿与尺寸。
motivation: 从图像构建可编辑3D场景需要每个物体的资产和放置资产的布局；3D生成与CAD检索已能提供资产，但布局仍缺乏通用方案：场景生成方法将布局与生成耦合，位姿估计器逐个物体处理且依赖真实尺寸CAD模型、深度或迭代优化。
method: 提出X-3DComposer，一个将布局预测与资产生成分离的前馈模型。给定一张或多张场景图像、物体掩码以及来自任意来源的每个物体资产，它将资产渲染视为视图，与场景图像一起送入由VGGT-Ω适配的多视图几何模型，并由每个物体渲染预测的相机以闭式解得到其旋转、平移和各轴缩放，单次前向约1秒；相机内参、相机位姿和深度为可选输入。
result: 在固定五种场景生成方法产出的网格、仅替换布局时，X-3DComposer的布局比这些方法的原生布局更准确；与独立布局模型SceneMaker相比，在来自六个室内数据集的测试集IndoorMix上将场景级Chamfer距离降低52%，在3D-FUTURE上降低28%。
conclusion: 结果表明布局可以作为独立的前馈任务，从任意视图和任意资产高效组合可编辑3D场景，并提升布局精度，同时兼容现有资产生成/检索与场景生成流程。

title: NRG-Twins: Pixel-Level Ground Truth for Rigidity Violations in Generated Videos
abstract: Video generators now produce realistic clips of scenes and objects, which makes generated video an attractive source of 3D content. Yet generated video is not 3D consistent: static content slowly deforms or slides, 3D reconstruction degrades, and the errors are too subtle to label by hand. To make generators 3D consistent, or to build rewards and guidance that push them there, we need data that say where and by how much a generated video breaks rigidity, and these data must come from generated video itself. We obtain per-pixel ground-truth labels from real-generated twins: a real clip paired with its re-creation by a keyframe-conditioned video generator. After inserting real keyframes so that the twin camera roughly follows the real one, we measure per pixel, in degrees, how far the twin departs from a rigid scene seen along its own camera path. We release Non-Rigidly Generated Twins (NRG-Twins), 871 twins, the code that builds them for new generators, and a benchmark with an official test split. A detector trained on these data, the Non-Rigidly Generated Pixel Detector (NRG-PD), predicts the per-pixel angle from RGB alone. It separates inconsistent from consistent pixels with AUROC 0.85, against 0.40-0.74 for seven existing consistency and motion-segmentation methods, and its predictions improve 3DGS of video that contains generated content.
tldr: 提出NRG-Twins像素级刚性违背真值数据集与NRG-PD检测器，可从RGB预测生成视频的非刚性角度。
motivation: 生成视频可作为3D内容来源，但存在静态内容缓慢形变或滑动、3D重建退化等非3D一致问题，且误差细微难以人工标注。为改进生成器或构建奖励与引导，需要来自生成视频本身的像素级刚性违背位置与程度数据。
method: 构建真实片段与其关键帧条件生成器重建片段配对的real-generated twins，插入真实关键帧使孪生相机大致跟随真实相机路径，再逐像素以角度度量孪生视频偏离刚性场景的程度。发布包含871个twins的NRG-Twins数据集、构建代码及带官方测试划分的基准，并训练仅从RGB预测逐像素角度的NRG-PD检测器。
result: NRG-PD在区分不一致与一致像素上达到AUROC 0.85，优于七种现有一致性与运动分割方法的0.40-0.74；其预测还能改善包含生成内容的视频的3DGS重建。
conclusion: 工作提供了像素级刚性违背真值、可扩展构建流程与官方基准，并证明从RGB预测非刚性角度的检测器优于现有方法，可用于提升生成视频的3D一致性及下游3D重建质量。

title: GOLD-SLAM: Gaussian-splatting Omnidirectional LiDAR-Depth SLAM
abstract: Panoramic cameras capture nearly the entire spherical field of view in a single frame. However, the mismatch between this panoramic coverage and the field of view of LiDAR poses a substantial challenge for panoramic Gaussian splatting SLAM that relies on LiDAR depth priors. We introduce GOLD-SLAM, a Gaussian-splatting Omnidirectional LiDAR-Depth SLAM system that combines high-quality rendering with accurate geometric reconstruction. It performs tracking and mapping in the spherical domain and uses tracked visual features in regions without LiDAR coverage to improve pose estimation. To address insufficient coverage of newly observed surfaces and floating artifacts during incremental mapping, we introduce Depth-Aware Map Extension and Pruning (DAEP). To enable broader evaluation, we collect a new dataset, WHOLE, using a UAV platform across Weak-geometry, High-dynamic, Omnidirectional, Low-light, and Easy scenarios. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks and WHOLE demonstrate competitive rendering quality and improved geometric accuracy relative to perspective systems. Compared with existing panoramic baselines, GOLD-SLAM improves mean PSNR by 5.56-9.10 dB and reduces mean Depth-L1 by 71.9-83.9%. To assess deployment feasibility on resource-constrained platforms such as UAVs, we evaluate an embedded configuration of GOLD-SLAM on a Jetson Orin NX (16 GB), demonstrating online operation at the cost of reconstruction quality.
tldr: GOLD-SLAM 融合全景相机与 LiDAR 深度先验，实现全向高斯泼溅 SLAM 的跟踪建图与高精度重建。
motivation: 全景相机单帧覆盖近全球面视场，但其视场与 LiDAR 覆盖不匹配，导致依赖 LiDAR 深度先验的全景高斯泼溅 SLAM 难以直接应用。
method: 系统在球域内进行跟踪与建图，并利用 LiDAR 未覆盖区域中跟踪到的视觉特征提升位姿估计；提出深度感知地图扩展与剪枝（DAEP）以缓解新观测表面覆盖不足和增量建图中的漂浮伪影。
result: 在公开基准和自建 WHOLE 数据集（覆盖弱几何、高动态、全向、低光照和简单场景）上，GOLD-SLAM 相比现有全景基线平均 PSNR 提升 5.56–9.10 dB，平均 Depth-L1 降低 71.9–83.9%；在 Jetson Orin NX（16 GB）上可在线运行但重建质量有所下降。
conclusion: GOLD-SLAM 在全向高斯泼溅 SLAM 中兼顾高质量渲染与几何重建精度，并验证了资源受限 UAV 平台上的部署可行性。

title: MaskedVGGT: Masked Multi-View Transformers Are Scalable 3D Learners
abstract: Multi-view feed-forward models show strong scalability, but their reliance on costly geometric annotations limits data scaling. Existing 3D self-supervised approaches reduce this reliance through cross-view completion (e.g., CroCo, MuM, Muskie) or novel-view synthesis (e.g., RayZer, E-RayZer), typically learning image representations and cross-view interactions jointly. We argue that learning single image representations from scratch is unnecessary for 3D pretraining methods, as doing so fails to benefit from the continuing advances in 2D foundation models (e.g., DINO, CLIP, frontier VLMs). We introduce MaskedVGGT, which freezes a strong pretrained 2D encoder and pretrains only an added, randomly initialized multi-view transformer, focusing on learning interactions across views. MaskedVGGT pretrains the multi-view transformer through masked self-distillation without annotations: a student predicts targets at masked locations based on complete anchor views and heavily masked remaining views, while an exponential-moving-average teacher provides prediction targets based on unmasked inputs. In experiments across model sizes up to 1B parameters, MaskedVGGT pretraining followed by fine-tuning outperforms single-stage supervised VGGT-$Ω$ training with the same training data, model architecture, and total number of optimization updates. MaskedVGGT also outperforms E-RayZer, CroCo, MuM, and Muskie, providing evidence for the effectiveness of building multi-view pretraining on strong 2D representations. Finally, extending pretraining with additional unlabeled videos further improves generalization, and the learned representations transfer to diverse downstream tasks. These results demonstrate an effective division of learning: reuse strong image representations from 2D pretraining and learn cross-view interactions from unlabeled multi-view data without relying on geometric annotations.
tldr: MaskedVGGT冻结2D编码器，仅用掩码自蒸馏预训练多视图Transformer，无需几何标注即可超越监督VGGT。
motivation: 多视图前馈模型扩展性强，但依赖昂贵的几何标注，限制了数据规模。现有3D自监督方法通常联合学习图像表示与跨视图交互，作者认为从零学习单图像表示不必要，且无法利用DINO、CLIP、前沿VLM等2D基础模型的持续进展。
method: MaskedVGGT冻结强预训练2D编码器，仅预训练随机初始化的多视图Transformer以学习跨视图交互。它通过无标注掩码自蒸馏训练：学生模型基于完整锚视图和高度掩码的其余视图预测被掩码位置的目标，指数滑动平均教师模型基于未掩码输入提供预测目标。
result: 在最大1B参数的模型规模上，MaskedVGGT预训练后微调在相同训练数据、模型架构和总优化更新次数下优于单阶段监督VGGT-Ω训练，并优于E-RayZer、CroCo、MuM和Muskie。加入额外无标注视频继续预训练还能提升泛化能力，所学表示可迁移到多种下游任务。
conclusion: 结果表明一种有效的学习分工：复用2D预训练的强图像表示，并从无标注多视图数据中学习跨视图交互，而无需依赖几何标注。该工作为可扩展的3D预训练提供了新路线，并显示基于强2D表示的跨视图预训练具有显著潜力。

title: ST-SfM: Spatio-Temporal Structure-from-Motion for Initialising 4D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Dynamic Gaussian splatting is usually initialised either with random points or with a structure-from-motion (SfM) cloud of the first frame. Neither says anything about what moves, where and when. We introduce ST-SfM, a sparse spatio-temporal SfM for synchronised, calibrated multi-camera video that splits the scene into two branches. Static structure is detected once per camera on a temporal-median image, gated for temporal stability and matched along epi-polar lines. Motion is detected as space-time interest points (STIPs) in the video volume, described with HOG3D and matched only between candidates that agree both epipolarly and in time. Union-find tracks that refuse inconsistent merges are triangulated with RANSAC over all view pairs, giving static 3D points and dynamic 4D points (x, y, z, t) with sub-frame times. We use ST-SfM derived sparse 4D cloud to initialise 4D Gaussian splatting. In comparison with random initialisation on N3DV scenes we get improvements in PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS.
tldr: ST-SfM 用稀疏时空 SfM 为 4D 高斯泼溅生成带运动信息的初始化点云。
motivation: 动态高斯泼溅通常用随机点或首帧 SfM 点云初始化，二者都不包含场景中什么在运动、在哪里运动以及何时运动的信息，导致初始化缺乏运动先验。作者希望为同步标定的多相机视频构建能同时表达静态结构与动态运动的稀疏时空点云，以改善 4D 高斯的初始化。
method: ST-SfM 将场景分为静态与动态两条分支：静态结构在每台相机的时间中值图像上检测一次，经时间稳定性门控后沿极线匹配；运动则以视频体中的时空兴趣点（STIP）检测，用 HOG3D 描述，仅在极线与时间上均一致的候选间匹配。随后用拒绝不一致合并的并查集构建轨迹，并对所有视角对做 RANSAC 三角化，得到静态 3D 点与带亚帧时间戳的动态 4D 点 (x, y, z, t)。
