title: Inclusive Hand Pose Estimation via Topology-Aware Distillation and Progressive Kinematic Reasoning
abstract: Hand pose estimation aims to recover the spatial configuration of hand joints from visual observations and serves as a fundamental perception module for downstream systems that rely on complete and topologically consistent hand representations. Most existing methods are developed under the assumption of fully articulated hand structures and tend to produce unstable or implausible predictions when parts of the kinematic structure are persistently absent, resulting in degraded performance or even system failure despite available partial observations. To study this challenge, we construct IncNYU, a physiologically constrained benchmark that simulates structural incompleteness through morphological modification of complete hand models and retains reference locations for both intact and synthetically removed regions. Based on this benchmark, we propose InsHaPE, an Inclusive Hand Pose Estimation framework designed to remain robust under structural incompleteness while preserving performance on standard, fully articulated hands. Built on hierarchical kinematic modeling, InsHaPE introduces two complementary components. First, a topology-aware distillation strategy transfers joint-level and relational priors from fully articulated hand representations, providing anatomically consistent initialization under missing structures. Second, a progressive kinematic reasoning module performs structured inference along the kinematic chain, enabling complete and anatomically consistent pose estimation under severe structural variations. Extensive experiments on NYU/IncNYU, together with external validation on MSRA, demonstrate that InsHaPE improves robustness under structural incompleteness while maintaining competitive performance on complete hands. System-level evaluations further show that InsHaPE improves robustness for downstream applications that require fixed-topology hand pose representations.
tldr: 提出InsHaPE，通过拓扑感知蒸馏与渐进运动学推理提升结构缺失手部姿态估计鲁棒性。
motivation: 现有手部姿态估计方法多假设手部关节结构完整，当运动链部分长期缺失时预测不稳定甚至系统失效；论文构建IncNYU基准以研究结构不完整场景。
method: 提出InsHaPE，基于分层运动学建模，包含拓扑感知蒸馏（从完整手表示迁移关节级与关系先验以提供解剖一致初始化）和渐进运动学推理（沿运动链结构化推断以应对严重结构变化）。
result: 在NYU/IncNYU及外部MSRA上验证，InsHaPE在结构不完整时提升鲁棒性，同时在完整手上保持有竞争力性能；系统级评估显示其有利于依赖固定拓扑手部表示的下游应用。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作提供结构缺失手部姿态估计基准与框架，通过蒸馏和运动学推理实现解剖一致预测，对需固定拓扑表示的下游系统具有应用价值。

title: ArborNet: Volume- and skeleton-aware completion of tree quantitative structure models from incomplete point clouds using anchor-conditioned graph learning
abstract: Terrestrial laser scanning (TLS) enables 3D reconstruction of trees and quantitative structure models (QSMs) for estimating woody volume and structural traits. However, occlusion in single-station or sparsely sampled TLS causes incomplete branch observations and biased volume estimates. Existing point-cloud completion methods recover plausible geometry but do not explicitly preserve branch topology, cylinder radii, or woody volume. We propose ArborNet, a volume- and skeleton-aware framework for completing tree structures in the QSM domain. Each tree is represented as a TreeQSM cylinder graph encoding cylinder geometry, branch level, parent-child topology, and branch identity. A multi-relation graph encoder propagates information across parent, child, and intra-branch connections. An anchor-conditioned decoder generates missing cylinders through terminal-branch continuation and new-branch generation. Geometry, existence, branch, radius, axis-smoothness, and volume losses encourage structural consistency. During inference, generated cylinders are selected under predicted level-wise missing-volume budgets. We evaluate ArborNet on DART-simulated TLS trees and urban TLS trees from Hong Kong, using single-station QSMs as partial inputs and multi-station QSMs as references. Under budget-constrained inference, ArborNet achieves mean total-volume relative error of 0.081% and mean level-wise volume error of 0.676% against reference QSMs, while reducing skeleton geometry error relative to evaluated point-cloud completion baselines. These errors quantify agreement with reference QSMs, not accuracy against destructively measured woody volume. Ablation results show that joint volume supervision is particularly important for volume control. These results demonstrate the potential of QSM-domain completion to recover explicit woody structure while constraining geometry and volume.
tldr: ArborNet在QSM域补全单站TLS树木结构，约束骨架、半径与材积，显著降低参考模型体积误差。
motivation: 单站或稀疏采样的地面激光扫描（TLS）受遮挡影响，常导致树枝观测不完整并使材积估计产生偏差。现有 point-cloud completion 方法虽能恢复合理几何，但不能显式保持树枝拓扑、圆柱半径和木质材积。
method: ArborNet 将每棵树表示为 TreeQSM 圆柱图，编码圆柱几何、枝级、父子拓扑和树枝身份，并用多关系图编码器在父、子及枝内连接间传播信息。锚点条件解码器通过末端枝延续和新枝生成补全缺失圆柱，训练时联合几何、存在性、树枝、半径、轴平滑和材积损失，推理时按预测的逐级缺失材积预算筛选生成圆柱。
result: 在 DART 模拟 TLS 树和香港城市 TLS 树上，以单站 QSM 为部分输入、多站 QSM 为参考，ArborNet 在预算约束推理下取得平均总材积相对误差 0.081% 和平均逐级材积误差 0.676%，并较所评估的 point-cloud completion 基线降低骨架几何误差。消融表明联合材积监督对体积控制尤为重要；上述误差衡量的是与参考 QSM 的一致性，而非对破坏性实测木质材积的精度。
conclusion: 结果表明，QSM 域补全能够在约束几何和材积的同时恢复显式木质结构，为不完整 TLS 树木 QSM 补全提供了有效途径。其贡献在于将补全目标从单纯点云几何扩展到拓扑、半径和材积一致的结构补全，并需注意结果依赖参考 QSM 而非破坏性实测材积。

title: RAGA: Refreshable Animatable Gaussian Avatars from a Single Photo
abstract: Avatars created from a single photo are fixed once made: regions the photo never showed, such as the back of a garment, are hallucinated and remain that way. We present Refreshable Animatable Gaussian Avatars (RAGA), a full-body Gaussian avatar that is created from a single image in about one second and can be refreshed whenever new images of the same person become available, without retraining or gradient-based optimization. RAGA maps each new observation into canonical UV space, accumulates it as visibility- and angle-weighted running sums, and re-decodes the fused map with the same decoder used for the photo. Although this decoder is trained only on single images, it makes use of the fused evidence. On 163 clips from five datasets, RAGA created from one photo outperforms LHM, LHM++ and IDOL, including on three datasets never used in training. Refreshing from later frames adds 0.49 dB PSNR overall and 0.68 dB on views turned at least 135° from the photo, where SSIM and LPIPS also improve. Given the same 16 images on all clips, LHM++ gains 0.15 dB, against 0.48 dB for RAGA. Creating an avatar takes 1.08 s and animating it 48.1 ms per frame on a laptop RTX 3080 GPU, with body fitting and matting included in creation and pose estimation included in animation. Code will be released on GitHub.
tldr: RAGA 从单张照片约 1 秒生成可动画全身 Gaussian 头像，并可在新图像到来时无需重训练地刷新。
motivation: 单张照片生成的头像在创建后即被固定，照片未展示的区域（如衣服背面）只能被幻觉补全且无法更新。研究目标是让全身 Gaussian 头像在新观测到来时可刷新，且无需重新训练或基于梯度的优化。
method: RAGA 将每个新观测映射到规范 UV 空间，以可见性和角度加权的方式累积为运行和，并用与单图生成相同的解码器重新解码融合后的特征图。该解码器虽仅在单张图像上训练，但能利用融合证据实现无需重训练的刷新。
result: 在五个数据集的 163 个片段上，RAGA 由单张照片创建的头像优于 LHM、LHM++ 和 IDOL，包括三个训练中未使用的数据集。利用后续帧刷新整体提升 0.49 dB PSNR，在相对照片旋转至少 135° 的视角提升 0.68 dB，SSIM 和 LPIPS 也改善；相同 16 张图像下 LHM++ 提升 0.15 dB，而 RAGA 提升 0.48 dB。创建耗时 1.08 秒，在笔记本 RTX 3080 GPU 上动画每帧 48.1 毫秒，创建包含身体拟合与抠图，动画包含姿态估计。
conclusion: RAGA 实现了从单张照片快速创建、可动画且可在线刷新的全身 Gaussian 头像，并在新视角质量和效率上取得优势。该方法为单图头像的持续更新提供了无需重训练的实用方案，代码将开源。

title: Div3DAfford: Diverse 3D affordance grounding
abstract: 3D affordance grounding aims to localize 3D regions specified by an interaction query. Existing methods predict a single affordance mask, overlooking the inherent diversity of human-object interactions. We introduce diverse 3D affordance grounding, a new task that requires predicting multiple plausible regions for a given object and affordance query. We then propose Div3DAffordNet, a transformer-based set prediction model capable of generating diverse affordance regions. To address the scarcity of diverse 3D affordance data, we develop an automated pipeline leveraging 2D generative models and 3D reconstruction techniques to synthesize 3D affordances, followed by lightweight human verification (reducing the annotation time by 72X), yielding the Div3DAfford benchmark. Extensive experiments show Div3DAffordNet effectively captures multi-mask affordance regions. Our method achieves the SOTA affordance grounding performance in the multi-mask setting, reducing GED-SIM from 0.745 to 0.492, while maintaining competitive single-mask performance on the standard benchmark of 19.0 mIoU.
tldr: 提出多样3D可供性定位新任务与Div3DAffordNet，并构建合成基准，显著降低多掩码GED-SIM。
motivation: 现有3D可供性定位方法仅预测单一掩码，忽略了人-物交互固有的多样性。该文提出多样3D可供性定位新任务，要求针对同一物体与交互查询预测多个合理区域，并面临多样3D可供性数据稀缺的问题。
method: 提出基于Transformer的集合预测模型Div3DAffordNet，可生成多个多样化的可供性区域。构建结合2D生成模型与3D重建的自动化数据合成管线，并辅以轻量人工校验（标注时间减少72倍），形成Div3DAfford基准。
result: 实验表明Div3DAffordNet能有效捕捉多掩码可供性区域，在多掩码设置下取得SOTA，将GED-SIM从0.745降至0.492；在标准单掩码基准上保持19.0 mIoU的竞争力。
conclusion: 该文定义了多样3D可供性定位任务，贡献了集合预测模型Div3DAffordNet与Div3DAfford基准，验证了多样性建模的有效性，并为后续多样3D可供性研究提供了数据与方法基础。

title: Not All Directions Are Flat: Decomposed-Gradient Flatness for Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Many applications of novel view synthesis, such as augmented reality and robotics, can afford only a few input views, since dense capture is costly. With such sparse views, however, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) overfits the training views and degrades at unseen viewpoints. Among the approaches to this problem, flat-minima optimization treats the Gaussians as trainable parameters and steers training toward flat minima, which generalize better, by perturbing the Gaussians with random noise or along the training gradient. However, these perturbations ignore their direction relative to the other training views. Interestingly, we find that the direction of the perturbation determines whether it improves generalization. Specifically, we decompose the gradient of each training view into a component parallel to the average gradient of all views, on which the views agree, and an orthogonal component, on which they disagree. Perturbing along the orthogonal component improves generalization, whereas perturbing along the parallel component does not. We further find that the flatness correction often opposes the reconstruction gradient, shrinking or even reversing the reconstruction step. Based on these findings, we propose DecoFlat, which perturbs each Gaussian along the orthogonal component together with random noise. Furthermore, we introduce a conflict-aware correction, which removes the part of the flatness correction that opposes the reconstruction gradient, and a rescheduling of the spherical-harmonics color, which suppresses the overfitting of view-dependent appearance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DecoFlat, as a plug-in optimizer, consistently improves vanilla 3DGS and a wide range of sparse-view 3DGS methods.
tldr: 提出DecoFlat，沿正交梯度扰动并抑制冲突校正，提升稀疏视角3DGS泛化。
motivation: 稀疏视角下3DGS易过拟合训练视角，在新视角上性能下降。现有flat-minima优化通过随机噪声或沿训练梯度扰动来提升泛化，但忽略扰动方向与其他训练视角的关系。
method: 将每个训练视角的梯度分解为与所有视角平均梯度一致的平行分量和视角间不一致的正交分量，发现仅沿正交分量扰动可提升泛化。DecoFlat沿正交分量加随机噪声扰动每个Gaussian，并引入冲突感知校正去除与重建梯度相反的flatness修正，同时重调度球谐颜色以抑制视角相关外观过拟合。
result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标；大量实验表明，DecoFlat作为即插即用优化器可稳定提升原始3DGS及多种稀疏视角3DGS方法。
conclusion: 工作揭示了扰动方向对稀疏视角3DGS泛化的关键作用，并提出方向感知的flatness优化插件DecoFlat，可广泛兼容现有稀疏视角3DGS方法并改善新视角合成泛化。

title: STAC++: Plug-and-Play Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Aware Cache Compression for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
abstract: Streaming 3D reconstruction must preserve geometry under limited memory, yet STAC's fixed-resolution spatial key-value (KV) cache grows as scenes expand. We propose STAC++, a plug-and-play, training-free framework that compresses and reuses spatial memory for long-term reconstruction in unbounded scenes. Adaptive Spatial KV Cache (ASKC) organizes KV states into an octree with adaptive resolutions across regions and layers. Response-Aware Cache Compression (RACC) guides KV merging by measuring attention-output changes, balancing storage savings with geometric preservation. Temporal Context Refinement (TCR) reuses cached intermediate features and recomputes only a short backbone suffix to refine historical predictions with later observations. Integrated into four pretrained streaming backbones, STAC++ reduces spatial memory consumption while maintaining competitive reconstruction quality on long sequences and large scenes, with further quality gains from refinement at limited computational overhead. The code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
tldr: STAC++提出免训练即插即用的自适应时空感知KV缓存压缩框架，在有限显存下实现无界场景的长序列流式三维重建。
motivation: 流式三维重建需在有限内存下保持几何精度，但现有STAC采用固定分辨率的空间KV缓存，随场景扩张而线性增长，难以支撑无界大场景的长序列重建。
method: 提出即插即用且免训练的STAC++框架：自适应空间KV缓存（ASKC）将KV状态组织为八叉树，并在区域与网络层间自适应分配分辨率；响应感知缓存压缩（RACC）以注意力输出变化量为准则指导KV合并，在存储节省与几何保真间取得平衡；时序上下文精炼（TCR）复用已缓存的中间特征，仅重算骨干网络末端短片段，以较小算力用后续观测修正历史预测。
result: 将STAC++集成到四个预训练流式重建骨干网络中，在长序列与大场景上显著降低空间内存占用，同时保持有竞争力的重建质量，并可在有限计算开销下通过时序精炼进一步提升质量；摘要未给出具体量化指标。
conclusion: STAC++以即插即用、免训练的方式缓解了流式三维重建的内存瓶颈，兼顾存储效率与几何保真，并具备跨骨干网络的通用性与可扩展性，代码将在录用后开源。

title: ArgsWorld: Unifying 3DGS Scene Reconstruction, Generation and Extrapolation with Autoregressive Diffusion Transformer
abstract: Autoregressive diffusion world models deliver strong video generation performance, yet they typically output only RGB frames rather than explicit 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scene representations, creating a gap between learned visual world dynamics and usable 3D assets for downstream robotics, simulation and rendering. To bridge this gap, we introduce ArgsWorld, an autoregressive diffusion model that also produces an explicit 3DGS scene. For each generation chunk, the diffusion transformer jointly processes clean historical image latents and noisy latents for new views. It keeps the historical image latents fixed and refreshes the scene features so that the Gaussian representation can be revised as new regions come into view. Our 3D Self-Forcing Distillation trains the model on its own generated histories using a mixture of single-view and multi-view data. Distribution matching supervises direct image latents and latents of Gaussian renderings at both generation and additional cameras. ArgsWorld unifies 3D scene reconstruction from posed images, scene generation from image or text prompts, and scene extrapolation across camera segments with disconnected endpoints. Experimental results demonstrate that ArgsWorld achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple 3D scene modeling tasks. Project page: https://m4a1tastegood.github.io/ArgsWorld/
tldr: ArgsWorld用自回归扩散Transformer统一3DGS场景重建、生成与外推。
motivation: 现有自回归扩散世界模型主要输出RGB视频帧，缺少显式3DGS场景表示，导致学习到的视觉世界动态难以转化为机器人、仿真和渲染可用的3D资产。本文旨在弥合视频世界模型与可用3D场景表示之间的鸿沟。
method: 提出ArgsWorld，在每个生成块中由扩散Transformer联合处理干净的历史图像latent与新视角的噪声latent，并固定历史图像latent、刷新场景特征以随新区域出现修正高斯表示。采用3D Self-Forcing Distillation在模型自身生成的历史上训练，混合单视图与多视图数据，并对直接图像latent及高斯渲染在生成相机和额外相机上的latent进行分布匹配监督。
result: 实验表明ArgsWorld在多个3D场景建模任务上取得state-of-the-art性能，并统一了基于位姿图像的3D场景重建、基于图像或文本提示的场景生成，以及跨端点不连续相机段的场景外推。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: ArgsWorld将自回归扩散世界模型与显式3DGS场景表示结合，使视频世界动态可直接产出可用的3D资产，并统一重建、生成与外推三类任务，有望促进机器人、仿真和渲染等下游应用。项目页面已公开。

title: SemGuard: Semantics-Decoupled Watermarking for Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Gaussian Splatting provides an efficient representation for high-fidelity rendering of static and dynamic 3D scenes, motivating the copyright protection of Gaussian assets. In CLIP-guided Gaussian watermarking, a universal message decoder pretrained on textual watermark representations is subsequently applied to visual features containing both watermark information and scene-dependent semantics. However, text-only pretraining does not explicitly account for the semantic interference encountered during watermark extraction. To address this challenge, we propose SemGuard, a simple yet effective semantics-decoupled watermarking framework that learns to suppress scene-dependent semantic interference during universal message decoder pretraining. Specifically, SemGuard combines message-related CLIP text features with message-independent visual features extracted from unwatermarked scene images, constructing training representations with controllable semantic interference relevant to the target Gaussian assets. A progressive semantic interference curriculum gradually increases the contribution of visual features, allowing the decoder to first learn reliable message representations and then adapt to increasingly strong scene-dependent semantic interference. After pretraining for a given message length and semantic image pool, the decoder is frozen and reused across multiple Gaussian assets whose visual semantics are covered by the pretraining data. Experiments on static and dynamic Gaussian Splatting assets demonstrate improved rendering fidelity alongside reliable watermark extraction, while evaluations on static assets further show enhanced robustness against image-space distortions.
tldr: 提出SemGuard语义解耦水印框架，以渐进语义干扰课程预训练通用解码器，提升高斯泼溅资产水印提取可靠性。
motivation: CLIP引导的高斯泼溅水印中，通用消息解码器仅用文本水印表示预训练，却需从同时包含水印信息和场景语义的视觉特征中提取消息，文本预训练未显式处理场景相关语义干扰，导致水印提取不可靠。
method: SemGuard将消息相关CLIP文本特征与来自无水印场景图像的消息无关视觉特征组合，构建语义干扰可控的训练表示；并采用渐进式语义干扰课程逐步增大视觉特征贡献，使解码器先学习可靠消息表示，再适应不断增强的场景语义干扰，预训练后冻结并复用于语义覆盖范围内的高斯资产。
result: 在静态与动态高斯泼溅资产上，SemGuard在提升渲染保真度的同时实现可靠水印提取；静态资产实验还表明其对图像空间失真具有更强鲁棒性（摘要未提供具体量化指标）。
conclusion: SemGuard通过解耦消息语义与场景语义干扰，为高斯泼溅资产版权保护提供简单有效的通用水印解码方案，并可跨多个语义覆盖的资产复用冻结解码器。

title: VUOD: A Versatile Unsupervised Outlier Detection Framework for Natural, Industrial, Medical Images and Beyond
abstract: Unsupervised outlier detection that automatically identifies whether visual systems involve anomalous images is a significant research topic. However, most approaches are limited to natural images because they rely on frozen and pre-trained feature extractors. So that their performance cannot be maintained in practical scenarios, especially for industrial inspection and medical imaging. In this work, we first revisit this task and then introduce a versatile unsupervised outlier detection framework to enrich the application domains. The core idea of this framework is to improve feature discriminativess via exploiting intrinsic distribution priors. Evaluated on 3 domains and 14 benchmark datasets, our proposed solution achieves state-of-the-art performance and significantly outperforms existing methods. More importantly, we show its plug-and-play property that can be integrated into diverse visual applications to improve their robustness, such as image classification and 3D reconstruction.
tldr: 提出通用无监督离群检测框架VUOD，利用内在分布先验提升特征判别性，跨自然、工业与医学图像取得SOTA。
motivation: 现有无监督离群检测多依赖冻结的预训练特征提取器，局限于自然图像，在工业检测和医学影像等实际场景中性能难以保持。
method: 提出VUOD通用框架，核心是利用数据内在分布先验增强特征判别性，实现跨领域无监督离群检测，并具备即插即用能力。
result: 在3个领域14个基准数据集上评估，VUOD达到SOTA并显著优于现有方法；还可嵌入图像分类、3D重建等视觉应用以提升鲁棒性。
conclusion: 该工作扩展了无监督离群检测的应用域，提供通用且可插拔的检测方案，对工业、医学及更广泛视觉任务具有潜在影响。

title: CAR3T: Generalizable Calibration-Guided Reference-View Attention Reuse for Multi-View 3D Transformers
abstract: Feed-forward multi-view 3D reconstruction relies on global attention for cross-view aggregation, but the attention cost grows quadratically with the number of views, making inference increasingly expensive for larger inputs. Existing acceleration methods compress tokens or sparsify attention, potentially losing geometric detail or restricting cross-view aggregation while leaving redundancy among attention outputs underexploited. We observe similar cross-view attention distributions in certain layers, revealing an opportunity to reduce repeated global aggregation through output reuse. However, the layers suitable for reuse vary with the input, and reusing one layer alters the features received by later layers. Similarity at individual layers therefore cannot characterize the combined effect of multiple reuse decisions on output drift. To address these challenges, we propose CAR3T, a training-free framework combining reference-view attention output reuse with offline risk calibration and online dynamic layer selection. Calibration models cumulative reuse risk, while online selection adapts reuse to each input under a calibrated budget. CAR3T retains all input tokens and attends to the keys and values of all views, reducing the core attention computation in selected layers from quadratic to linear. Experiments on VGGT, DA3, and $π^3$ show forward speedups up to $1.41\times$ with at most 100 views and $1.75\times$ on longer sequences, with accuracy trade-offs across backbones and datasets.
tldr: CAR3T以免训练的风险校准与动态层选择复用参考视图注意力输出，将选定层核心注意力从二次降为线性，实现多视图3D Transformer加速。
motivation: 多视图3D重建中的全局注意力计算随视图数二次增长，现有token压缩或注意力稀疏化会损失几何细节或限制跨视图聚合，且未充分利用注意力输出冗余。
method: 提出免训练CAR3T框架：离线校准多层级联复用风险，在线为每个输入动态选择可复用层；被选层复用参考视图注意力输出，同时保留全部输入token并访问所有视图的key/value，使核心注意力由二次降为线性。
result: 在VGGT、DA3和π^3上，最多100视图时前向加速最高1.41×，更长序列最高1.75×；不同骨干与数据集上存在精度权衡。
conclusion: CAR3T在不训练的情况下缓解多视图3D Transformer的注意力瓶颈，为可扩展的跨视图聚合提供实用加速路径，并揭示输出复用需结合累积风险校准与输入自适应选择。

title: VG3R: Video Generation Model for Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
abstract: Video generation models are widely used as 3D priors for novel view synthesis and 3D scene generation. Fine-tuned for perception, generation models also excel at dense prediction such as depth estimation. However, methods that apply video generation models to 3D reconstruction either predict depth without cameras or generate geometry and estimate cameras through many iterative denoising steps, which makes them slower. In this paper, we present $\textbf{VG3R}$, which turns a pretrained video generation model into a feed-forward 3D reconstruction model. Our key observation is that such a model already captures the depth and camera motion of a video, but not in the form required for reconstruction. We introduce two components: $\textit{clip-level shift prediction}$, which corrects depth distortion caused by the unknown shift in decoded inverse depth, and a $\textit{multi-layer camera head}$, which predicts per-frame cameras parameters by combining features across transformer blocks. Using Wan2.1 as its video backbone, VG3R reconstructs a scene and estimate the camera of every frame without iterative denoising. It achieves the lowest ATE and reconstruction errors among methods built on video generation models, runs about 4 and 14 times faster than Aether and Geo4D. VG3R also demonstrates competitive depth estimation and 3D reconstruction performance compared with geometry foundation models. Project page: https://github.com/KTH-RPL/VG3R
tldr: VG3R将预训练视频生成模型转为无需迭代去噪的前馈3D重建与相机估计模型。
motivation: 现有将视频生成模型用于3D重建的方法要么只预测深度而不估计相机，要么需通过多步迭代去噪生成几何并估计相机，导致速度较慢。本文旨在构建一个快速的前馈模型，同时完成场景重建与逐帧相机估计。
method: 作者观察到预训练视频生成模型已隐含视频中的深度与相机运动，但形式不适合直接重建。VG3R引入clip-level shift prediction校正解码逆深度中未知偏移造成的深度畸变，并设计multi-layer camera head融合Transformer各层特征以预测逐帧相机参数；以Wan2.1为视频骨干，无需迭代去噪即可前馈输出重建与相机。
result: 在基于视频生成模型的方法中，VG3R取得最低的ATE和重建误差，运行速度分别约为Aether和Geo4D的4倍和14倍；其深度估计与3D重建性能也可与几何基础模型竞争。
conclusion: VG3R证明预训练视频生成模型可被高效转化为前馈3D重建器，在避免迭代去噪的同时提升速度与精度，为快速3D感知和场景重建提供了新路线。

title: VeilGS: Solving Darkness as a Veil of 2D Basis Maps over Retinex 3DGS
abstract: In a dark capture, the darkness is not uniform. How much light reaches a surface depends on where it lies relative to the few light sources, and the camera compresses what remains with a tone curve. Most low-light 3D reconstruction methods either apply one curve to every pixel of a view, so a dark object beside a lamp and a bright one in an unlit corner receive the same correction, or store the darkness in the 3D representation, where it can absorb scene detail. We present VeilGS, a 3D Gaussian Splatting method for low-light novel view synthesis that treats the degradation as a veil drawn over a clear scene. Each Gaussian carries an albedo and a shading latent instead of spherical harmonics, separating surface colour from illumination. Each view is darkened by a spatially varying gain followed by a global tone curve, and rendering without this veil gives the restored scene. A small network predicts a coarse basis for the gain from the observation, and its coefficients are solved for each view rather than learned. Training through this solve discourages the Gaussians from absorbing what the veil can explain. VeilGS needs no paired normal-light supervision and stores no per-view parameters. On Gaussian-DK, its restored renders score best on no-reference NIQE and CLIP-IQA and are rated highest in a blind user study with 55 participants. On LOM, it achieves results competitive with the state of the art.
tldr: VeilGS将低光退化建模为覆盖清晰场景的二维基图遮罩，在Retinex框架下实现无需配对监督的低光新视角合成。
motivation: 低光拍摄中的暗度并不均匀，取决于表面相对少量光源的位置，并受到相机色调曲线压缩。现有低光三维重建方法要么对整幅视图统一施加校正曲线，要么将暗度存入三维表示中，导致场景细节被吸收。
method: VeilGS基于3D Gaussian Splatting，为每个高斯携带albedo与shading latent而非球谐函数，以分离表面颜色与光照。每幅视图先经空间变化增益再经全局色调曲线变暗，去除该veil即可渲染恢复场景；小网络从观测预测增益的粗略基，其系数按视图求解而非学习，训练通过该求解过程抑制高斯吸收可由veil解释的成分。
result: 在Gaussian-DK上，恢复渲染在无参考NIQE与CLIP-IQA指标上最佳，并在55名参与者的盲测用户研究中获得最高评分；在LOM上取得与当前最优方法相当的结果。
conclusion: VeilGS通过显式veil分解有效解决低光新视角合成中的非均匀暗度与细节吸收问题，无需配对正常光监督且不存储逐视图参数，具有实际应用潜力。

title: BladeR: Scalable, Shape-Guided 3D Reconstruction of Wind Turbine Blades from UAV Imagery
abstract: The structural integrity of wind turbine blades is critical for safe, efficient energy production. Accurate 3D reconstruction allows precise localization and quantification of wear and early damage detection. While drone-based inspections are standard, their high-resolution imagery poses challenges such as weak texture, lighting variability, and high computational cost. We present BladeR, a scalable pipeline for high-quality 3D reconstruction from inspection imagery. A hierarchical sparse reconstruction strategy leverages GPS/IMU data and blade shape priors to guide advanced keypoint matchers on full-resolution images. For dense reconstruction, a tiled Gaussian Splatting framework processes 45 MP images at native resolution, isolates the blade from background, and adaptively enhances detail recovery along the leading edge. Validation against commercial and open-source baselines shows significant improvements in model completeness and detail.
tldr: BladeR 提出一种可扩展的形状引导三维重建流程，利用分层稀疏重建与分块高斯泼溅从无人机图像高质量重建风机叶片。
motivation: 风机叶片结构完整性对安全高效发电至关重要，精确三维重建可用于磨损定位量化和早期损伤检测。无人机巡检图像分辨率高但存在弱纹理、光照变化和计算成本高等问题，亟需可扩展的高质量重建方法。
method: BladeR 采用分层稀疏重建策略，结合 GPS/IMU 与叶片形状先验引导全分辨率图像上的先进关键点匹配器；稠密阶段使用分块 Gaussian Splatting 框架在原生分辨率处理 45 MP 图像，分离叶片与背景并自适应增强前缘细节恢复。
result: 与商业和开源基线相比，BladeR 在模型完整性和细节恢复方面取得显著提升；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该方法为风机叶片提供可扩展的高质量三维重建方案，有助于磨损定位、量化与早期损伤检测，并具备在无人机巡检中实际应用的潜力。

title: InterBand-EMG: A Cross-Band Foundation Model for Generalizable Hand-Pose Estimation
abstract: Surface electromyography (sEMG) enables continuous hand-pose estimation, but learning representations that generalize across users and movements remains challenging. We introduce InterBand-EMG, which combines band-specific quantization with cross-band reconstruction and structured masked code prediction to learn transferable EMG representations for hand-pose tracking. We also introduce SynapMyo, an eight-channel EMG-to-pose dataset comprising 1,227.74 hand-hours from 499 users across 68 movement categories. Experiments on emg2pose and SynapMyo show that InterBand-EMG outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in joint-angle accuracy across all three generalization settings on both datasets. The source code and the SynapMyo dataset will be publicly released upon acceptance of this paper.
tldr: 提出跨频带基础模型InterBand-EMG并发布SynapMyo数据集，实现跨用户与跨动作的手部姿态估计。
motivation: 表面肌电（sEMG）可用于连续手部姿态估计，但学习能够跨用户、跨动作泛化的表征仍然具有挑战性。
method: 提出InterBand-EMG，将频带特定量化与跨频带重建、结构化掩码码本预测相结合，学习可迁移的EMG表征以用于手部姿态跟踪；同时构建SynapMyo八通道EMG到姿态数据集，包含499名用户、68类动作、共1227.74手时。
result: 在emg2pose和SynapMyo上的实验表明，InterBand-EMG在两种数据集的全部三种泛化设置下，关节角度精度均优于当前最优基线。
conclusion: 该工作提升了sEMG手部姿态估计的跨用户与跨动作泛化能力，并将公开源代码和SynapMyo数据集（论文录用后发布）。

title: EAST: Event-Anchored Surface Transport for Event-Based Gaussian Reconstruction
abstract: Event-supervised Gaussian reconstruction combines the high temporal resolution and wide dynamic range of event cameras with efficient explicit rendering. However, recovering a continuous surface remains difficult: changes in rendered appearance can compensate for depth errors while preserving the predicted brightness changes. We introduce Event-Anchored Surface Transport (EAST), which couples an event-constrained signed distance field to Gaussian rendering. Triangulation-supported candidates anchor the zero set, while normal flow measured from event timing constrains ray-surface intersection depths. Gaussian centers receive bounded corrections from the descriptor difference between the live field and a frozen initial reference. The correction is zero at initialization, yet transmits image gradients to the live field. Experiments on PAEv3D and NeRF Synthetic show improved surface accuracy and reference-view rendering over Gaussian baselines, together with efficient mesh extraction from the learned field.
tldr: EAST将事件约束SDF与高斯渲染耦合，提升事件重建的表面精度与参考视图渲染。
motivation: 事件监督的高斯重建虽兼具高时间分辨率、宽动态范围与高效显式渲染，但仅靠渲染外观变化可补偿深度误差并保持预测亮度变化，导致连续表面难以恢复。
method: 提出EAST，将事件约束的符号距离场与高斯渲染耦合：用三角化支持的候选锚定零水平集，用事件时序测得的法向流约束射线-表面交点深度；高斯中心根据实时场与冻结初始参考的描述子差异获得有界修正，修正初始为零但可把图像梯度传给实时场。
result: 在PAEv3D和NeRF Synthetic上，相比高斯基线提升了表面精度与参考视图渲染，并可从学习到的场中高效提取网格；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: EAST通过事件锚定的表面传输缓解外观补偿深度误差的问题，为事件监督高斯重建提供更准确的连续表面和高效网格提取，具有推动事件相机高质量重建的潜力。

title: HumanoidPose: Monocular 3D Pose Estimation for Humanoid Robots
abstract: As humanoid robots increasingly enter real-world environments, recovering their 3D whole-body pose from monocular imagery is becoming increasingly important for external state perception, motion analysis, and robot learning. However, Humanoid Robot Pose Estimation (HRPE) lies at the intersection of conventional Robot Pose Estimation (RPE) and Human Pose Estimation (HPE), while not being fully addressed by either paradigm: RPE primarily focuses on non-humanoid robots, particularly fixed-base manipulators, whereas HPE is built upon human-specific skeletal topologies, body models, and motion priors. Despite recent progress in humanoid 2D keypoint detection and HPE adaptation, humanoid-native 3D pose recovery remains insufficiently studied, and a dedicated benchmark with suitable training data and evaluation protocols is still lacking. To address this gap, we introduce Humanoids, a benchmark for monocular 3D humanoid robot pose estimation, and propose HumanoidPose, a framework for this task. Humanoids provides synthetic 3D supervision across diverse humanoid embodiments, manually annotated real-world 2D data, and real-world RGB sequences paired with robot states for 3D evaluation on a physical Roban humanoid. HumanoidPose combines human-inspired visual perception with robot articulation modeling and explicit kinematic grounding. Experiments on Humanoids and the DHRP-H1 benchmark demonstrate strong performance in articulation recovery and 3D pose estimation, including zero-shot transfer to real-world 2D and 3D evaluation. Ablation studies further show the contribution of robot-native articulation modeling and explicit kinematic grounding. The dataset and code will be publicly released to support future research in the community.
tldr: 提出Humanoids基准与HumanoidPose框架，实现人形机器人单目3D全身姿态估计。
motivation: 人形机器人单目3D全身姿态估计处于传统机器人位姿估计与人姿态估计的交汇处，但现有RPE主要面向非人形固定基座机械臂，HPE依赖人类特定骨骼拓扑、人体模型与运动先验，均无法充分覆盖该任务。尽管人形2D关键点检测和HPE适配已有进展，人形原生3D位姿恢复仍研究不足，且缺乏专用训练数据、评测协议与基准。
method: 构建Humanoids基准，提供跨多种人形本体的合成3D监督、人工标注真实2D数据，以及在实体Roban人形机器人上采集的RGB序列与机器人状态用于3D评测。提出HumanoidPose框架，将类人视觉感知、机器人关节建模与显式运动学 grounding 相结合。
result: 在Humanoids与DHRP-H1基准上的实验表明，方法在关节恢复和3D位姿估计上表现较强，并支持零样本迁移到真实世界2D与3D评测；消融实验验证了机器人原生关节建模和显式运动学 grounding 的贡献。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作填补了人形机器人单目3D位姿估计在专用基准与原生方法上的空白，并提供可公开的数据集与代码，有望促进外部状态感知、运动分析和机器人学习等后续研究。

title: EgoSurgHands: An Egocentric 3D Hand Pose Dataset & Benchmark for Open Surgery Training
abstract: Surgical skill assessment, AR guidance, and robot learning from demonstration all benefit from 3D tracking of the surgeon's hands, yet no surgical dataset offers real egocentric articulated 3D hand pose. We introduce EgoSurgHands, a benchmark for real-captured egocentric hand pose estimation in open surgery training on synthetic pads. Captured with multi-sensor glasses, it contains 41,909 training hand-instance rows across 55 procedure recordings and 9,476 human-validated evaluation rows across 13 held-out recordings, spanning 13 tasks, 3 glove colors, and 4 trainees from first-year medical student to third-year resident. Each frame carries a multi-sensor stack: intrinsics, hand landmarks with per-hand confidence, timestamps, and eye gaze, plus SLAM extrinsics where SLAM succeeded. Evaluation labels combine sensor-fused pseudo-ground truth, human cross-review of every frame, surgeon adjudication of flagged cases, and an independent multi-view triangulated reference. Alongside the within-corpus, procedure-disjoint split, a leave-one-wearer-out protocol tested unseen trainees. Across eight methods evaluated zero-shot, from MANO-based reconstructors to the two-hand IntagHand and the keypoint-only MediaPipe Hands, egocentric pretraining was associated with stronger transfer on every held-out wearer. WildHands and JointTransformer had 18\% and 40\% lower PA-MPJPE, respectively, than the non-egocentric HaMeR. JointTransformer was the best performing model with an error of 14.95 mm. A substantial surgical domain gap remains, and the widely deployed MediaPipe Hands detected a hand in only 24.1\% of evaluation rows. As a baseline, a 58K-parameter residual corrector (JRN) on frozen backbones reached 10.96-14.85 mm PA-MPJPE on held-out wearers for the two ego-pretrained backbones. We release the dataset and benchmark code at https://egosurghands.github.io
tldr: 提出EgoSurgHands开放手术训练第一视角3D手部姿态数据集与基准，含多传感器标注和留人评估。
motivation: 手术技能评估、AR引导和机器人示范学习均需对术者手部进行3D跟踪，但现有手术数据集缺乏真实采集的第一视角关节化3D手部姿态标注。
method: 用多传感器眼镜采集55段操作、13类任务，提供内参、手部关键点及置信度、时间戳、眼动和SLAM外参；评估标签融合传感器伪真值、逐帧人工复核、外科医生裁定与多视角三角化参考，并设过程不交叉和留一佩戴者协议。
result: 零样本评测8种方法，JointTransformer最佳PA-MPJPE为14.95 mm；WildHands和JointTransformer较非第一视角HaMeR分别低18%和40%，MediaPipe Hands仅24.1%评估帧检出；冻结骨干加58K参数JRN达10.96–14.85 mm。
conclusion: 发布数据集与基准代码，揭示第一视角预训练迁移优势及显著手术域差距，为开放手术训练的手部姿态估计提供可复现评测基础。

title: SGAR: Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction via Sparse Geometry-Guided Attention
abstract: Feed-forward models have been very successful in 3D reconstruction with ad hoc attention designs that relate all view patches densely. However, the cost of this dense global attention grows quadratically with the number of views, preventing the model from applying to larger-scale reconstruction settings. In this paper, we argue that most dense attention computations are unnecessary from a classical structure-from-motion perspective: 3D structures stem from geometrically matching regions in 2D. We bring this principle to learning-based feed-forward reconstruction with our Sparse Geometric Attention Reconstruction (SGAR) method. In SGAR, each patch token attends to only a small set of patch tokens from other views, chosen by a lightweight learned key selection module trained to predict cross-view 3D proximity of tokens. Thus, dense global attention is replaced by much more efficient geometric-similarity-guided sparse attention. SGAR is a general method that can be applied to different feed-forward models by fine-tuning. In our experiments, we show that SGAR is the fastest among both state-of-the-art dense and sparse methods and the most accurate sparse one. It runs up to 12-times faster than dense attention at 1,000 views with stable pose accuracy where existing sparse methods fail, and shows the best performance in reconstructing more complete geometries on the same time budget.
tldr: SGAR用稀疏几何引导注意力替代稠密全局注意力，实现更快更准的大规模前馈三维重建。
motivation: 现有前馈三维重建模型采用稠密全局注意力关联所有视图patch，计算量随视图数二次增长，难以扩展到大规模场景；作者从运动恢复结构角度认为多数稠密注意力计算并非必要。
method: 提出SGAR，用轻量级可学习关键选择模块预测跨视图token的三维邻近性，使每个patch token仅关注其他视图中少量几何相关token，从而以几何相似性引导的稀疏注意力替代稠密全局注意力，并可通过微调应用于不同前馈模型。
result: 实验表明SGAR在稠密与稀疏SOTA方法中速度最快，并在稀疏方法中精度最高；在1000个视图时较稠密注意力最高快12倍，且位姿精度稳定，而现有稀疏方法失效；在相同时间预算下重建出更完整几何。
conclusion: SGAR将经典几何匹配先验引入前馈重建的注意力设计，在保持位姿精度的同时显著提升大规模重建效率与完整性，为可扩展的三维重建提供了通用方案。

title: FirstCross: Convex Single-Photon 3D Reconstruction from Sparse Views
abstract: Single-photon lidar records the arrival time of each returning photon, enabling 3D reconstruction from few views and scarce photons. However, leading neural methods such as Transientangelo require over an hour of non-convex per-scene optimization, and their accuracy degrades as photon flux decreases. We propose FirstCross, a network-free approach that instead solves a short sequence of convex problems on a voxel grid. For a solid object, the Poisson likelihood of a ray with given signal and background rates depends on the scene solely through its first crossing, the point where the ray first enters the object. Decomposing this likelihood yields two tractable terms. The first penalizes surfaces in front of detected photons and admits a tight convex closure, namely volume rendering with a running-maximum transmittance in place of NeRF's product transmittance. The second accounts for photons that no surface explains and admits a convex upper bound once the object is assumed to be thick behind each detected surface point. Compared with Transientangelo under its own real-data protocol, FirstCross achieves lower depth error across every test scene, view count, and flux level. With three views and 100 times fewer photons than at the protocol's lowest flux, our mean object depth error stays under half of Transientangelo's with all photons. Given our detected surface points, the best classical fusion has 1.3 to 1.8 times our three-view error across flux levels. On real room-scale captures with 1% of their photons, TransientNeRF has 2.8 to 7.7 times our error. FirstCross lets few-view single-photon scanners cut exposure to 1% and reconstruct an object in about a minute on one GPU.
tldr: FirstCross 用体素网格上的凸优化从稀疏视角单光子数据快速重建三维物体。
motivation: 现有基于神经网络的单光子三维重建（如 Transientangelo）需逐场景非凸优化超过一小时，且光子通量降低时精度显著下降；本文旨在实现少视角、少光子条件下快速且鲁棒的三维重建。
method: FirstCross 是无需网络的体素网格方法，利用泊松似然仅依赖光线首次进入物体的交点这一性质，将似然分解为两项可处理项：一项用运行最大值透射率替代 NeRF 乘积透射率形成紧凸闭包，另一项在物体表面后足够厚假设下为无法解释的光子构造凸上界，并求解短序列凸问题。
result: 在 Transientangelo 的真实数据协议下，FirstCross 在所有测试场景、视角数和光子通量下深度误差均更低；三视角且光子数比协议最低通量少 100 倍时，平均物体深度误差仍不到 Transientangelo 使用全部光子时的一半。经典融合方法误差为本文三视角结果的 1.3–1.8 倍；真实房间尺度 1% 光子数据上，TransientNeRF 误差为本文的 2.8–7.7 倍，且单 GPU 约一分钟完成重建。
conclusion: FirstCross 将少视角单光子扫描曝光量降至 1%，在约一分钟内完成物体重建，表明凸优化可在稀疏视角与极低光子条件下替代非凸神经优化，为快速单光子 3D 重建提供新路线。

title: CryoGaussian: Heterogeneous Cryo-EM Reconstruction Made Explicit with Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Single-particle cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) determines macromolecular structures from noisy particle images. However, rare, transient compositional states and subtle, continuous conformational variation are difficult to resolve. We present CryoGaussian, a Gaussian splatting method for heterogeneous cryo-EM reconstruction that fits an explicit Gaussian density representation directly to the particle images through a differentiable rasterizer rendering orthographic line integrals modulated by the contrast transfer function. The Gaussians are initialized randomly, with their number derived from the estimated spatial support of the molecular density and their minimum size bounded by the Nyquist frequency of the particle images. To capture the compositional and conformational variation across particle images, we learn particle-image and per-Gaussian latents that jointly modulate the base position, amplitude, and scale of each Gaussian. Each structural state is then reconstructed by fitting the Gaussians conditioned on its inferred latent. On CryoBench, CryoGaussian achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction accuracy for both compositional and conformational heterogeneity. On experimental data, it resolves a rare compositional state of the 50S ribosomal subunit (class C4, 1.3% of particles) with rRNA helix 68 docked in the absence of the central protuberance, and continuous conformational motion of the SF3b and helicase subcomplexes of the pre-catalytic spliceosome. We further optimize the rasterizer for additive cryo-EM projection, reducing training time by 12.8-28.0$\times$.
tldr: CryoGaussian 用高斯泼溅显式建模异质冷冻电镜重构，实现高精度与加速。
motivation: 单颗粒冷冻电镜可从噪声粒子图像确定大分子结构，但稀有瞬态组成状态和细微连续构象变异难以解析。
method: 提出 CryoGaussian，以显式高斯密度表示直接拟合粒子图像，通过可微光栅化器渲染受 CTF 调制的正交线积分；高斯随机初始化，数量由密度空间支撑估计确定，最小尺寸受 Nyquist 频率约束；学习粒子图像与逐高斯隐变量联合调制高斯基位置、幅值和尺度，并基于推断隐变量条件重建各结构状态。
result: 在 CryoBench 上，CryoGaussian 在组成异质性和构象异质性两类任务上均取得 state-of-the-art 重构精度；在实验数据中解析了仅占 1.3% 粒子的 50S 核糖体亚基稀有组成状态（class C4，rRNA helix 68 对接且中心突起缺失），并捕捉 pre-catalytic spliceosome 中 SF3b 与 helicase 子复合物的连续构象运动；优化后的加性投影光栅化器将训练时间缩短 12.8–28.0×。
conclusion: CryoGaussian 通过显式高斯泼溅实现异质冷冻电镜重构，可解析稀有组成状态与连续构象变化，并在精度和训练效率上表现优异，为冷冻电镜异质性分析提供了可解释且高效的新路线。

title: Domain-Aware Conformal Prediction for Trustworthy Spacecraft Pose Estimation under Sim-to-Real Shift
abstract: Autonomous rendezvous and proximity operations require not only an accurate estimate of the pose of the target spacecraft, but also a reliable indication of when this estimate can be trusted. Conformal prediction provides such an indication with a formal guarantee, by producing pose uncertainty sets that contain the true pose with a specified probability. Such a guarantee, however, assumes that calibration and test data follow the same distribution, an assumption that is violated in orbital perception, where labelled calibration images are available only from synthetic renderings while operational images are real. In this work, we show on the SPEED+ dataset that conformal pose estimation calibrated on synthetic images loses its coverage guarantee on real images, and that many of the resulting failures are silent: the predicted pose set appears valid but excludes the true pose. To address this, we calibrate on synthetic images translated to the appearance of real images. Since translation alters appearance while preserving geometry, the synthetic pose labels remain valid and no labelled real images are required. Experiments with two translation models show that this calibration restores coverage above the specified level for miscoverage levels of 0.1 and above, and reduces silent failures from up to 43.5% to at most 3.3% of the test images, bringing conformal pose estimation a step closer to trustworthy deployment in space.
tldr: 提出域感知共形预测，用真实外观迁移校准，恢复航天器位姿估计覆盖并大幅减少静默失败。
motivation: 自主交会与近距离操作不仅需要准确估计目标航天器位姿，还需要可靠判断估计何时可信。共形预测可提供带形式保证的位姿不确定集，但其同分布假设在仅有合成标定图像、测试为真实在轨图像时被违反，导致真实图像上覆盖保证失效并出现静默失败。
method: 在SPEED+数据集上验证合成图像校准的共形位姿估计在真实图像上失去覆盖保证后，提出将合成图像迁移到真实图像外观再进行校准。由于外观迁移保持几何不变，合成位姿标签仍然有效，且无需任何带标签的真实图像；实验采用两种图像迁移模型。
result: 实验表明，该域感知校准在误覆盖水平0.1及以上恢复了达到指定水平的覆盖，并将静默失败从最多43.5%的测试图像降至最多3.3%。
conclusion: 该方法无需真实标签即可缓解仿真到现实的分布偏移，使共形位姿估计更接近航天器在轨可信部署。其贡献在于揭示并量化了合成校准在真实图像上的静默失败，并给出保持几何标签有效的域感知校准方案。

title: PaveSplat: Resolution-Robust Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting with Residually Corrected Surface-Aligned Covariances
abstract: We present PaveSplat, a feed-forward Gaussian splatting method that adds a learned residual to the analytic surface-aligned covariance, keeping surfels paving the visible surface across rendering resolutions. Pixel-aligned feed-forward Gaussian splatting predicts one primitive per pixel from a few images in a single pass, and its rendering quality depends on how well these primitives cover the surface. Recent surfel-based methods compute the surface-aligned covariance analytically from predicted depth. However, this covariance has no way to correct the surfel orientation where the depth-derived frame is ill-posed. The surfels then cover the surface loosely; at the training resolution each surfel's one-pixel minimum footprint covers the gaps, but they show up as holes when the same prediction is re-rendered at a higher resolution. To address this, we keep the analytic covariance as an initialization, with its axes aligned to the surface tangents, and add an identity-initialized unit-quaternion residual that reorients a surfel only where this improves rendering, turning surfels that the analytic frame mis-aims back onto the surface. On RealEstate10K, PaveSplat achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS among single-Gaussian-per-pixel methods at every scale (1x-8x). The native-resolution gain is small; the benefit appears when the same prediction is rendered at higher display resolutions without re-running the network. On zero-shot DL3DV, it leads PSNR within this group at every scale and ranks first or second on SSIM/LPIPS. A coverage-hole analysis shows fewer uncovered pixels than both baselines under high-resolution re-rendering.
tldr: PaveSplat 在解析表面对齐协方差上学习残差四元数，使前馈高斯泼溅在高分辨率重渲染时不再出现孔洞。
motivation: 像素对齐的前馈高斯泼溅对每个像素只预测一个图元，其渲染质量取决于这些图元对表面的覆盖程度。现有基于 surfel 的方法从预测深度解析计算表面对齐协方差，但当深度导出的坐标系病态时，该协方差无法修正 surfel 朝向，导致 surfel 只是松散地覆盖表面；在训练分辨率下，每个 surfel 的最小一像素足迹可以掩盖这些缝隙，但用同一预测结果在更高分辨率重渲染时，缝隙就会变成孔洞。
method: PaveSplat 保留解析协方差作为初始化，让其轴与表面切向对齐，并在其上叠加一个以单位四元数初始化的残差，仅当能改善渲染时才重新定向 surfel，从而把被解析坐标系错误指向的 surfel 重新贴合回表面；整个流程为单次前馈，无需针对显示分辨率重新运行网络。
result: 在 RealEstate10K 上，PaveSplat 在 1x–8x 所有尺度下均取得单像素单高斯方法中最佳的 PSNR、SSIM 与 LPIPS；原生分辨率下增益较小，优势主要体现在用同一预测结果提升显示分辨率重渲染时。在零样本 DL3DV 上，该方法在该组方法中所有尺度下 PSNR 领先，SSIM/LPIPS 排名第一或第二；覆盖孔洞分析显示，在高分辨率重渲染下其未覆盖像素数少于两个基线方法。
conclusion: 通过残差四元数修正病态深度坐标系下的 surfel 朝向，PaveSplat 以极小的原生分辨率代价换取了跨渲染分辨率的鲁棒覆盖质量，为前馈高斯泼溅在可变显示分辨率下的实用化提供了简洁有效的方案。

title: Multi-View Transformer with Geometry-Guided Multi-Modal ControlNet for 3D Virtual Try-On
abstract: Editing a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) capture of a person so that they wear a new garment requires every rendered view to agree on the same garment details. Existing 3D virtual try-on (VTON) pipelines, however, edit training views largely independently and fuse them with hand-designed heuristics such as manually chosen reference views and fixed attention-blending weights. The resulting inconsistencies are baked into the 3D representation and surface as texture drift, blurred prints, and implausible geometry in novel views. We present GS-VTON-MVT, a three-stage framework that combines implicit and explicit 3D reasoning for consistent 3DGS try-on. (i) A multi-view inpainting transformer jointly edits a set of training views with full cross-view self-attention, so that cross-view correspondence is learned rather than imposed. (ii) A geometry-guided multi-modal ControlNet conditions the diffusion editor on the garment image together with depth and surface normals rendered from the current 3DGS state, supplying explicit structure where visual evidence is weakest. (iii) A pose-adaptive persona-aware attention replaces the fixed blending weight between current-view and reference-view features with weights derived from camera-pose proximity. On the 3D-VTONBench benchmark, GS-VTON-MVT improves FID, KID, LPIPS-based cross-view consistency, and user preference over general-purpose 3D editors and prior 3D try-on methods.
tldr: 提出三阶段GS-VTON-MVT框架，通过多视角Transformer与几何引导ControlNet实现一致的3DGS虚拟试穿。
motivation: 现有3D虚拟试穿流程基本独立编辑各训练视角，并依赖人工选择参考视角和固定注意力融合权重等启发式方法，导致跨视角不一致被固化进3D表示，在新视角中出现纹理漂移、印花模糊和几何不合理等问题。
method: GS-VTON-MVT采用三阶段框架：多视角修复Transformer以完整跨视角自注意力联合编辑训练视角，学习而非强制跨视角对应关系；几何引导多模态ControlNet将服装图像与当前3DGS状态渲染的深度和表面法线共同作为条件，为视觉证据薄弱区域提供显式结构；姿态自适应人物感知注意力用相机位姿邻近度替代当前视角与参考视角特征间的固定融合权重。
result: 在3D-VTONBench基准上，GS-VTON-MVT在FID、KID、基于LPIPS的跨视角一致性和用户偏好方面优于通用3D编辑器和已有3D试穿方法；摘要未提供具体量化数值。
conclusion: 该工作结合隐式与显式3D推理，使跨视角对应关系可学习，并从条件控制和特征融合层面提升3DGS虚拟试穿的一致性，有望减少新视角纹理漂移与几何伪影。

title: AGSR: Aperture-Guided Super-Resolution for Gaussian Splatting
abstract:
3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables real-time novel view synthesis, but Gaussian rasterization attenuates fine-scale scene structure through the projected covariance of each primitive. We show that contracting these projected covariances at inference time can mitigate the effective bandwidth limitation induced by finite Gaussian footprints, motivating a multi-aperture rendering framework for super-resolution.
  Based on this insight, we propose AGSR (Aperture-Guided Super-Resolution), a lightweight inference-time framework that progressively fuses multi-aperture renderings using uncertainty-guided feature aggregation and geometric conditioning from transmittance and depth cues. AGSR operates as a plug-in enhancement for pre-trained 3DGS models.
  Experiments on the Mip-NeRF 360 benchmark show that AGSR outperforms lightweight image-space super-resolution baselines, with gains increasing as the underlying Gaussian representation deteriorates. The results provide evidence that covariance contraction exposes bandwidth-sensitive structural cues attenuated by native Gaussian rasterization. AGSR achieves these improvements while maintaining real-time performance with up to 139k parameters.
tldr: AGSR通过推理时收缩高斯投影协方差并融合多孔径渲染，实现轻量实时的3DGS超分辨率增强。
motivation: 3DGS 可实现实时新视角合成，但高斯光栅化会因每个基元的投影协方差而衰减细尺度结构；有限高斯足迹造成有效带宽受限。
method: 提出 AGSR，一种推理时轻量框架：在推理时收缩投影协方差以生成多孔径渲染，并利用不确定性引导的特征聚合以及透射率和深度线索的几何条件进行渐进融合；可作为预训练 3DGS 模型的即插即用增强模块。
result: 在 Mip-NeRF 360 基准上，AGSR 优于轻量级图像空间超分辨率基线，且当底层高斯表示退化时增益增大；模型仅需最多 139k 参数并保持实时性能。
conclusion: 结果表明协方差收缩能够显露被原生高斯光栅化衰减的带宽敏感结构线索；AGSR 以轻量即插即用方式提升预训练 3DGS 的超分辨率表现，具有实际增强潜力。

title: SCCV-6D: Sparse Canonical Coordinate Voting for Holistic Multi-View RGB-D 6D Pose Estimation in Robotic Bin Picking
abstract: Industrial bin picking requires pose estimates that are accurate under clutter, partial occlusion, and the reflective, texture-less nature of manufactured parts. Most recent approaches to 6D pose estimation follow multi-stage pipelines. These achieve high accuracy, but incur memory and runtime footprints that do not cope with the operational constraints of many real-world industrial deployments. Holistic pipelines estimate poses in a single pass, with cost controlled through indiscriminate subsampling or lowered resolution. Continuing this line, we present SCCV-6D, a fully sparse multi-view RGB-D estimator. We reconstruct the 3D space at millimeter precision, prune background via a staged heatmap mechanism, and predict class, translation offset and rotation at highest resolution for an arbitrary number of objects simultaneously. Rotation is formulated as canonical coordinate voting. Points vote for their canonical object coordinates with an associated confidence, enabling closed-form pose recovery with a symmetry-aware weighted Procrustes solve. Along an in-cluster point recovery induced by offset votes, this removes time-consuming post-processing stages. We reuse the task-supervised attention priors from the heatmap formulation for a novel attention-gated distillation objective that reweights teacher-student feature alignment. On the IPD test split we report competitive 0.826 AP at 1.13 s per scene, significantly faster than the leading entries. On MV-YCB our approach reaches 96.1 ADD-S, and remains competitive even on the densely packed bins of ROBI.
tldr: 提出全稀疏多视图RGB-D位姿估计器SCCV-6D，在杂乱工业料箱场景中兼顾精度与速度。
motivation: 工业料箱抓取需要在杂乱、部分遮挡以及反光、无纹理零件条件下获得准确6D位姿，而多阶段方法虽精度高但内存和运行时间难以满足实际部署约束，整体式方法又常依赖盲目子采样或降低分辨率控制成本。
method: SCCV-6D构建毫米级精度的全稀疏多视图RGB-D表示，通过分阶段热图机制裁剪背景，并在最高分辨率下同时预测任意数量物体的类别、平移偏移和旋转；旋转采用带置信度的规范坐标投票，结合对称性感知加权Procrustes求解实现闭式位姿恢复，并利用偏移投票完成簇内点恢复以去除耗时后处理，同时复用热图任务监督注意力先验设计注意力门控蒸馏目标。
result: 在IPD测试集上取得0.826 AP，每场景耗时1.13 s，显著快于领先方法；在MV-YCB上达到96.1 ADD-S，并在密集堆叠的ROBI料箱上保持竞争力。
conclusion: 该工作以单次全稀疏多视图RGB-D流程实现有竞争力的6D位姿精度和较快运行速度，减少后处理阶段，对工业料箱抓取部署具有潜在价值。

title: Multi-View Relighting with Mergeable Radiance Fields
abstract: We propose MergeableRF, a method for radiance field relighting through model parameter merging. Given multi-view images of a scene under known basis lights, our goal is to relight the scene by directly combining the parameters of radiance fields trained under these lights. This is motivated by the linearity of light transport: the image under a mixture of lights is the same weighted combination of the images under each light. However, combining the parameters of independently trained radiance fields does not produce the corresponding combination of images. To address this, we represent a scene with shared geometry and a separate appearance network for each basis light. We start these networks from the same initialization and introduce merge-aware training, which teaches their parameter combinations to reproduce the corresponding combinations of images. Given a target HDR environment map, we compute its basis-light coefficients and use them to merge the appearance networks into a single relit model. Our method supports both Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), without material estimation, additional relighting networks, or target-specific optimization. Unlike image-space blending, it requires only one rendering pass per viewpoint. Experiments on synthetic Neural Gaffer objects and real OLATverse captures demonstrate relighting quality competitive with methods trained on the same multi-light observations.
tldr: 提出MergeableRF，通过合并各基光外观网络参数实现无需目标优化的多视图重光照。
motivation: 利用光传输线性，混合光照图像应为各基光图像的加权组合；但独立训练的辐射场参数直接合并并不能产生对应的图像组合，因此需要让辐射场参数具备可合并性。
method: 采用共享几何与每个基光独立外观网络的表示，从相同初始化出发，并用merge-aware training约束外观网络参数组合复现对应图像组合；给定目标HDR环境图后计算基光系数，将外观网络合并为单一重光照模型，支持NeRF和3DGS，无需材质估计、额外重光照网络或目标特定优化。
result: 在合成Neural Gaffer物体和真实OLATverse捕获上实验，重光照质量与使用相同多光照观测训练的方法相当；摘要未提供具体量化指标，且相较图像空间混合每视角仅需一次渲染。
conclusion: 提出了一种通过合并辐射场参数实现多视图重光照的框架，避免目标特定优化和图像空间混合，兼容NeRF与3DGS，为高效多光照场景重光照提供了新思路。

title: Mesh-Free Keypoint Learning for Category-Level 6D Object Pose Estimation
abstract: Category-level 6D pose estimation relates partial RGB-D observations of unseen instances to a canonical frame shared across a category. Object-aware reconstruction helps adaptive keypoints retain the geometry of the visible surface. Common reconstruction targets select observed points by their distance to a registered instance surface. We present MORSEPose, which derives this support directly from standard pose and metric-size annotations. We map observed 3D points to normalized object coordinates and retain those inside a tolerancedilated pose-and-size envelope. This construction is consistent across camera frames and metric scales. When the annotated extent bounds the object surface, the envelope conservatively contains the support of a conventional surface-distance selector. We integrate this target with multi-level RGB-D features, adaptive keypoints, and learnable category context. Experiments on REAL275 and HouseCat6D show that the envelope closely matches surface-based supervision at both point and task levels, remains stable under boundary perturbations and viewpoint changes, and supports competitive category-level pose accuracy across benchmarks.
tldr: 提出MORSEPose，用位姿与尺寸包络替代表面距离选择重建点，实现无网格类别级6D位姿估计。
motivation: 类别级6D位姿估计需将未见实例的部分RGB-D观测关联到类别规范帧，现有方法常依赖配准后的实例表面按距离选择重建点，限制了对标准标注的直接利用。本文旨在不依赖网格或表面距离选择器的情况下，从位姿与度量尺寸标注中直接构造重建监督。
method: MORSEPose将观测3D点映射到归一化物体坐标，并保留落在由位姿和度量尺寸构造的容差膨胀包络内的点，形成跨相机帧与度量尺度一致的支撑集；当标注范围包住物体表面时，该包络可保守包含传统表面距离选择器的支撑集。方法将该目标与多级RGB-D特征、自适应关键点和可学习类别上下文集成。
result: 在REAL275和HouseCat6D上，包络监督在点级和任务级均与基于表面的监督接近，在边界扰动和视角变化下保持稳定，并在多个基准上取得有竞争力的类别级位姿精度；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 研究表明可利用标准位姿与尺寸标注构造无网格、跨帧一致的重建监督，避免对配准实例表面的依赖，为类别级6D位姿估计提供了更简洁且稳健的监督方式，并具备在真实RGB-D场景中推广的潜力。

title: Stereo Visual Odometry with In-the-Loop Geometric Feed-Forward Models Towards Dense Metric Mapping
abstract: We present a stereo visual odometry (SVO) framework that integrates geometric feed-forward models (GFMs) for dense depth prediction with factor-graph-based visual odometry to achieve accurate localisation and dense metric mapping. Our key idea is to exploit sparse but reliable metric geometry estimated from stereo and temporal multi-view observations to calibrate dense GFM predictions, while retaining the robustness and efficiency of model-based SVO. Rather than directly conditioning the GFM on potentially noisy stereo depth, optimised 3D landmarks are used to jointly estimate a scale-shift transformation over all keyframes within each local submap, yielding metrically consistent dense depth predictions. To balance accuracy and computational efficiency, we introduce a hierarchical factor-graph architecture. At the local level, sliding-window optimisation estimates high-frequency camera poses and multi-view-refined 3D landmarks. Dense predictions are generated only for selected keyframes and registered within each submap using SE(3) Generalised ICP. Consecutive submaps are further aligned in Sim(3) using their shared geometry, allowing residual scale inconsistencies to be corrected. These intra- and inter-submap constraints are incorporated into a global factor graph to produce a consistent trajectory and dense metric reconstruction. Extensive experiments on public and in-house datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves competitive odometry accuracy against geometric and learning-based baselines while providing accurate dense metric reconstruction and improved robustness to failures in learned depth prediction.
tldr: 提出闭环耦合几何前馈稠密深度模型与因子图优化的立体视觉里程计，实现稠密度量建图。
motivation: 传统模型法SVO稳健高效，但难以直接获得稠密度量深度；学习型稠密深度预测易受噪声和尺度不一致影响。需要利用稀疏但可靠的立体与多视图度量几何校准稠密预测，同时保持SVO的鲁棒性与效率。
method: 利用优化后的3D路标在每个局部子图内联合估计所有关键帧的尺度-平移变换，以校准GFM稠密深度预测；构建分层因子图，局部滑窗估计高频位姿与多视图精化路标，关键帧稠密预测经SE(3) Generalized ICP配准，连续子图用共享几何做Sim(3)对齐，并将子图内与子图间约束纳入全局因子图。
result: 在公开和自建数据集上，该方法相对几何与学习型基线取得有竞争力的里程计精度，并能输出准确的稠密度量重建；摘要未提供具体量化指标，但报告了对学习深度预测失败更强的鲁棒性。
conclusion: 该工作表明，将可靠稀疏度量几何作为闭环约束校准前馈稠密模型，可在保持模型法SVO效率与鲁棒性的同时获得一致轨迹和稠密度量地图，对SLAM与稠密建图具有潜在价值。

title: VideoRNG: Relightable Neural Gaussians from Generative Video Models
abstract: Generating realistic 3D assets remains constrained by classical representations: surface meshes and compact physically based materials struggle to express objects whose appearance arises from fine geometry or complex light transport, while existing Gaussian-splatting generators typically bake fixed illumination into appearance. We introduce VideoRNG, a two-stage method that generates complete, relightable 3D assets from a text prompt or a single image without prescribing a mesh or analytic material model. A video generator fine-tuned from a pretrained video diffusion backbone first produces a structured RGBA turntable sequence under a known pose, camera, and illumination. A feed-forward large reconstruction model initialized from a pretrained video diffusion backbone then maps the video-VAE latent frames of selected turntable frames directly to millions of anisotropic Gaussians with learned neural appearance features. A shared directional decoder and stochastic Gaussian ray tracer turn this representation, which we call ray-traced Relightable Neural Gaussians (rtRNG), into radiance under novel viewpoints and illumination. To preserve high-frequency appearance while learning geometry, we introduce depth-anchored appearance training, and we make million-Gaussian reconstruction practical through foreground token selection and cost-aware distributed sampling. VideoRNG generates complex assets such as fur, feathers, and spider webs that can be interactively rendered, relit, and integrated into scenes.
tldr: VideoRNG 用两阶段视频扩散与高斯重建从文本或单图生成可重光照的 3D 资产。
motivation: 现有表面网格与紧凑 PBR 材质难以表达由精细几何或复杂光传输决定外观的物体，而现有 Gaussian-splatting 生成器通常将固定光照烘焙进外观，导致无法重光照。本文旨在无需预设网格或解析材质模型，从文本或单张图像生成完整可重光照 3D 资产。
method: VideoRNG 采用两阶段路线：先微调预训练视频扩散骨干，在已知姿态、相机与光照下生成结构化 RGBA 转台序列；再以预训练视频扩散骨干初始化的前馈大重建模型，将选定帧的 video-VAE 隐特征直接映射为数百万各向异性高斯及学习到的神经外观特征。共享方向解码器与随机高斯光线追踪器将 rtRNG 表示转化为新视角和新光照下的辐射度，并通过深度锚定外观训练、前景 token 选择与代价感知分布式采样兼顾高频外观与百万级高斯重建效率。
result: 摘要未提供量化指标；实验展示该方法可生成毛皮、羽毛和蜘蛛网等传统表示难以表达的复杂资产，并支持交互式渲染、重光照及场景集成。
conclusion: VideoRNG 证明了可从生成视频模型构建完整、可重光照的神经高斯 3D 资产，无需网格或解析材质模型，为复杂外观资产的生成、编辑与场景级集成提供了新路线。
